Authors: Pranav Goyal, Andrew Stratton, Christoforos Mavrogiannis

TACTIC: Temporal and Context-Aware LLM Tactical Planning for Roadside LiDAR Attacks AutonomousDriving

multimodal LLM LiDAR attack scene graph tactical planning CARLA simulation

简要说明：TACTIC 利用多模态大语言模型实现场景感知的激光雷达攻击战术规划，在 CARLA 仿真中通过适应交通环境实现 100% 的碰撞率。

TLDR: TACTIC uses a multimodal LLM for scene-aware tactical planning of LiDAR attacks in autonomous driving, achieving a 100% collision rate in CARLA simulations by adapting attack primitives to traffic context.

Abstract: Physical LiDAR attacks are often evaluated using fixed primitives and manually selected parameters, despite their strong dependence on surrounding traffic. We present TACTIC, a scene-aware framework that uses a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to coordinate state-adaptive roadside LiDAR attacks. Under a gray-box threat model, TACTIC relies only on an attacker-operated roadside perception stack, without accessing the victim LiDAR's native point clouds or internal processing. Local perception provides metric vehicle states, while the MLLM combines these measurements with roadside imagery to infer relational traffic context and construct a semantic scene graph. Based on this representation, TACTIC selects and configures two complementary primitives: \emph{push-away}, which shifts the perceived range of a lead vehicle, and \emph{phantom-obstacle braking}, which triggers emergency braking through obstacle injection. Measured traffic states and empirically calibrated constraints ground the generated tactics in physically feasible operating regions. To accommodate MLLM latency, TACTIC overlaps reasoning and execution asynchronously while high-rate local perception detects scene changes and triggers replanning. Across 280 randomized CARLA trials, the full policy achieves a 100% collision rate, compared with 35% for a fixed rule, 60% for random selection, and 75% for a restricted LLM using mode selection with default parameters. Joint physical-and-image input achieves 100% success, versus 65% with physical measurements alone and 75% with imagery alone, while asynchronous $Δ$ refresh reduces scene-mutation response from 7.4 s to 2.0 s. These results show that scene-dependent tactical planning can expose context-sensitive LiDAR failure modes that fixed attack policies may miss.

摘要（中文）：物理LiDAR攻击的有效性往往高度依赖于周围交通环境，然而现有评估通常采用固定攻击原语并人工设定参数。我们提出TACTIC——一种场景感知攻击框架，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）协调状态自适应的路侧LiDAR攻击。在灰盒威胁模型下，TACTIC仅依赖攻击者操控的路侧感知栈，无需访问受害者LiDAR的原始点云或内部处理流程。局部感知模块提供车辆状态的度量信息，而MLLM将这些测量数据与路侧图像相结合，推断交通上下文关系并构建语义场景图。基于该场景表示，TACTIC选择并配置两种互补的攻击原语：\emph{推离}（\emph{push-away}），用于偏移前车被感知到的距离；以及\emph{幻影障碍制动}（\emph{phantom-obstacle braking}），通过注入虚拟障碍物触发紧急制动。实测交通状态与经验校准约束共同确保所生成攻击策略处于物理可行的作用范围内。为适应MLLM的推理延迟，TACTIC将推理与执行异步重叠进行，同时依靠高速局部感知实时检测场景变化并触发重新规划。在280次随机化CARLA仿真实验中，完整策略实现了100%的碰撞率，而固定规则、随机选择以及使用默认参数的受限LLM模式选择策略的碰撞率分别为35%、60%和75%。联合物理与图像输入时成功率可达100%，而仅使用物理测量或仅使用图像时成功率分别为65%和75%；异步$Δ$刷新机制将场景突变响应时间从7.4秒缩短至2.0秒。上述结果表明，依赖场景的战术规划能够揭示固定攻击策略可能遗漏的上下文敏感型LiDAR失效模式。

Authors: Yiming Gao, Shaocheng Luo

Magnetic based In-situ Self 3D Pose Estimation for a Modular Soft Tendon-Driven Continuum Robot via IMU-Fusion Manipulation

continuum robot pose estimation IMU fusion magnetic sensing closed-loop control

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于软连续体机器人的嵌入式位姿感知框架，通过融合IMU和磁场数据实现无外部相机的实时3D位姿估计，并通过闭环控制验证。

TLDR: This paper presents an embedded pose sensing framework for soft continuum robots, fusing IMU and magnetic field data for real-time 3D pose estimation without external cameras, validated through closed-loop control.

Abstract: Continuum robots are well suited for gentle manipulation because of their inherent compliance and ability to adapt to complex environments. However, their continuously deformable structure makes accurate configuration estimation challenging, particularly when external vision systems are unavailable or obstructed. In this work, we present an embedded pose sensing framework that combines inertial measurement units (IMUs) and active magnetic fields to estimate the robot configuration without relying on external cameras. The angular measurements from the IMU and magnetic-field references are fused to improve local orientation estimation and reduce accumulated orientation error during operation. This pose sensing scheme achieves an update rate of 16.7~Hz, allowing real-time feedback. The proposed system is experimentally validated through closed-loop control, where the estimated robot configuration is used to maintain the end-effector at a desired position while interacting with an object. These results demonstrate the potential of distributed magnetic--inertial sensing for real-time pose estimation and closed-loop control of continuum robots.

摘要（中文）：连续体机器人因其固有的柔顺性和适应复杂环境的能力，非常适合轻柔操作任务。然而，其连续可变形结构使得精确位形估计具有挑战性，尤其是在外部视觉系统不可用或受阻的情况下。本文提出了一种嵌入式姿态感知框架，该框架结合惯性测量单元（IMUs）与主动磁场，无需依赖外部相机即可估计机器人位形。通过融合IMU的角度测量与磁场参考信息，可改善局部朝向估计，并减小运行过程中累积的朝向误差。该姿态感知方案实现了16.7 Hz的更新速率，能够支持实时反馈。所提系统通过闭环控制实验进行了验证，在实验中，估计得到的机器人位形被用于维持末端执行器在与物体交互时的期望位置。这些结果展示了分布式磁-惯性传感在连续体机器人实时姿态估计与闭环控制中的潜力。

Authors: Zheng Cao, Guo Ning Sue, Xiangyun Bu, David Quinn, Junzhe Hu, Carmel Majidi

RL-Guided PAC-NMPC for Probabilistically-Safe Perception-Based Navigation in Unknown Environments RLRobot

PAC-NMPC reinforcement learning perception-based navigation probabilistic safety fixed-wing aerial vehicle

简要说明：本文结合强化学习与随机非线性模型预测控制（PAC-NMPC），在未知环境中实现基于感知的概率安全导航，并在敏捷固定翼飞行器上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper combines reinforcement learning with stochastic nonlinear model predictive control (PAC-NMPC) to achieve probabilistically-safe, perception-based navigation in unknown environments, demonstrated on an agile fixed-wing aerial vehicle.

Abstract: In this paper, we present an approach for combining stochastic nonlinear model predictive control (SNMPC) and reinforcement learning (RL) to enable probabilistically-safe perception-based navigation in unknown environments. Our method first uses RL to train probabilistic actor-critic and sensor prediction models. We then leverage these probabilistic models in a sampling-based SNMPC framework known as Probably Approximately Correct (PAC)-NMPC, which uses hard constraints to enforce finite-time statistical guarantees on the probability of collision and value function improvement. By ensuring that our finite-horizon SNMPC policies decrease the value function in expectation, we can approach the long-horizon performance of the RL approach while satisfying probabilistic safety constraints. Through simulation experiments, we show that our approach can improve the safety of perception-based RL navigation policies and scale to high dimensional systems with large sensor input spaces and complex nonlinear dynamics. We also demonstrate our approach through hardware experiments, showing improved performance for vision-based navigation with an agile fixed-wing aerial vehicle in unknown environments.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种结合随机非线性模型预测控制（SNMPC）与强化学习（RL）的方法，以实现在未知环境中基于感知的概率安全导航。我们的方法首先利用强化学习训练概率演员-评论家模型及传感器预测模型。随后，我们将这些概率模型应用于一种基于采样的SNMPC框架，即“近似正确”（PAC）-NMPC，该框架通过硬约束确保有限时间内碰撞概率与价值函数改进的统计保证。通过确保我们的有限时域SNMPC策略在期望意义上降低价值函数，我们能够在满足概率安全约束的同时，接近强化学习方法的长时域性能。通过仿真实验，我们展示了该方法能够提升基于感知的强化学习导航策略的安全性，并能扩展到具有高维传感器输入空间和复杂非线性动力学的高维系统。我们还通过硬件实验验证了该方法，展示了在未知环境中使用敏捷固定翼飞行器进行视觉导航时性能的提升。

Authors: Adam Polevoy, Dillon Capalongo, Katherine Tang, Mark Gonzales, Marin Kobilarov, Joseph Moore

Beyond Policy Alignment: Closing the Planning-Learning Loop for Robot Control with Learned World Models HumanoidEmbodied

model predictive control world models humanoid control sim-to-real TD-MPC

简要说明：本文提出了 PL-MPC，通过修改评论家监督、规划器终端值估计和演员蒸馏来增强 TD-MPC 框架，从而在高维人形控制上提升性能，并在七自由度机器人上成功实现仿真到现实的迁移。

TLDR: This paper introduces PL-MPC, which enhances the TD-MPC framework by modifying critic supervision, planner terminal-value estimation, and actor distillation to improve performance on high-dimensional humanoid control and succeed in sim-to-real transfer on a 7-DoF robot.

Abstract: Planning with learned world models combines online trajectory optimization with learned value and policy functions for high-dimensional control. Because the planner determines the experience used for learning, while the learned critic and actor in turn score and propose future plans, planning and learning form a closed feedback loop. TD-MPC is a prominent instance of this design. Recent policy-constrained variants strengthen one part of the loop by aligning the learned policy with planner behavior. We introduce PL-MPC (Planning-Learning MPC), which additionally modifies critic supervision and planner terminal-value estimation. Hybrid multi-step TD targets expose critic updates to more realized rewards before bootstrapping; disagreement-aware terminal estimates reduce the influence of uncertain critic values during MPPI planning; and return-weighted actor distillation emphasizes planner-executed actions from high-return episodes. The world-model architecture and MPPI optimizer are otherwise unchanged. On HumanoidBench, the largest gains occur on \texttt{balance-hard}, where Total Average Return (TAR) increases from $98\pm18$ to $387\pm255$, and \texttt{hurdle}, from $199\pm13$ to $466\pm200$; performance across the broader benchmark remains task dependent, and PL-MPC remains competitive on DMControl. Controlled ablations show different component interactions across the two tasks. We further demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on wrench-nut alignment with a 7-DoF KUKA IIWA14, obtaining higher observed success than TD-M(PC)^2 on the training object size and two unseen sizes. Code and data will be available at: https://pl-mpc-humanoid.github.io.

摘要（中文）：基于学习的世界模型进行规划，将在线轨迹优化与学习得到的价值函数和策略函数相结合，以应对高维控制问题。由于规划器决定了用于学习的经验，而学习得到的评论家与行动者又反过来对候选规划进行评分和提议，规划与学习由此形成了一个闭环反馈系统。TD-MPC便是这一设计的典型代表。近期引入的策略约束变体通过使学习得到的策略与规划器行为对齐，强化了该闭环中的一部分环节。我们提出了PL-MPC（规划-学习MPC），该方法进一步修改了评论家的监督信号以及规划器的终端价值估计。混合多步TD目标使评论家的更新在自举之前接触到更多已实现的奖励；基于分歧感知的终端估计减少了MPPI规划过程中不确定评论家价值的影响；而基于回报加权的行动者蒸馏则强调从高回报回合中提取规划器实际执行的动作。除上述改动外，世界模型架构与MPPI优化器保持不变。在HumanoidBench基准测试中，性能提升最为显著的任务是\texttt{balance-hard}，其总平均回报（TAR）从$98\pm18$提升至$387\pm255$；以及\texttt{hurdle}任务，从$199\pm13$提升至$466\pm200$。在更广泛的基准测试中，性能表现仍取决于具体任务，而PL-MPC在DMControl上保持了竞争力。受控消融实验揭示了两个任务中不同组件间的交互差异。我们进一步展示了在7自由度KUKA IIWA14机械臂上进行扳手螺母对中任务的零样本仿真到现实迁移能力，在训练目标尺寸及两种未见尺寸上均获得了高于TD-M(PC)^2的实测成功率。代码与数据将发布在：https://pl-mpc-humanoid.github.io。

Authors: Kowndinya Boyalakuntla, Yuhan Liu, Abdeslam Boularias

Whole-Body Aerial Grasping and Lifting via Partial Visual Observations Manipulation

aerial grasping teacher-student framework recurrent policy partial observations whole-body control

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于全身空中抓取和提升的循环师生框架，在仿真中训练单个策略，学习从部分视觉观测中协调飞行、手臂运动和夹爪闭合，并在仿真中展示了高成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a recurrent teacher-student framework for whole-body aerial grasping and lifting, training a single policy in simulation that learns to coordinate flight, arm motion, and gripper closure from partial visual observations, and demonstrates high success rates in simulation.

Abstract: Aerial grasp-and-lift tasks require whole-body coordination across approach, acquisition, and lifting under partial target observations. Early approach failures can limit exposure to later task stages during training, while changing visibility complicates alignment and closure timing during execution. We present a recurrent teacher-student framework that learns a single policy in simulation to jointly command flight, arm motion, and gripper closure without an explicit task-phase input. A privileged teacher learns through reinforcement learning with a critical-state curriculum that exposes acquisition and lifting states before connecting them to normal approach trajectories. Its behavior is distilled into a recurrent visual student that replaces privileged target states with dual-view point clouds and proprioception, integrating observation history for closed-loop control. A dedicated closure objective supervises closure timing from sustained model-defined readiness sequences. Training and primary evaluation use a simulated acquisition-and-payload model with condition-triggered latching, virtual attachment, and wrench-based payload loading for short-distance lifting. Across 8,996 completed simulation episodes under this model, the frozen student achieves full-task success rates of 99.97%, 97.14%, and 95.84% under nominal, physics/control-randomized, and additional camera-randomized conditions, respectively. The nominal latch-count-weighted mean of per-seed 90th-percentile alignment errors at acquisition is 8.12 mm.

摘要（中文）：空中抓取与提升任务需要在部分目标观测条件下，跨越接近、抓取和提升阶段实现全身协调。训练过程中，早期的接近失败可能限制对后续任务阶段的接触，而可见性的变化则给执行阶段的对准和闭合时机带来复杂性。我们提出了一种循环教师-学生框架，在仿真中学习单一策略，无需显式任务阶段输入即可联合控制飞行、机械臂运动和夹爪闭合。特权教师通过强化学习结合关键状态课程进行训练，该课程在将抓取和提升状态与正常接近轨迹衔接之前，先使其暴露于这些状态。其行为被提炼至一个循环视觉学生模型中，该模型以双视角点云和本体感觉替代特权目标状态，并整合观测历史以实现闭环控制。专门的闭合目标函数通过模型定义的持续就绪序列监督闭合时机。训练和主要评估使用一个模拟的抓取-载荷模型，该模型具备条件触发的锁闭机制、虚拟连接以及基于力矩的载荷加载，用于短距离提升。在该模型下完成的8，996次仿真回合中，冻结的学生模型在标称、物理/控制随机化以及额外相机随机化条件下，分别实现了99.97%、97.14%和95.84%的全任务成功率。标称条件下，各随机种子第90百分位对准误差的锁存计数加权平均值为8.12毫米。

Authors: Jiaye Jin, Rui Jin, Xinhang Xu, Haotian Jin, Ruiyang Liu, Yi Wang, Jiayan Zhao, Kun Cao, Lihua Xie

Making Waves: A Membrane-Coupled Delta Array for Manipulating Objects Below the Actuator Spacing Manipulation

distributed manipulation delta robot array membrane-coupled surface discrete cosine transform policy parallel object manipulation

简要说明：本文提出一种膜耦合的8x8并联机器人阵列，通过连续可变形表面突破执行器间距对可操作物体尺寸的限制，并利用基于DCT系数的学习策略实现多物体并行操作，且可直接迁移至硬件。

TLDR: This paper introduces a membrane-coupled 8x8 delta robot array that forms a continuous deformable surface, eliminating the actuator-spacing limit on object size and enabling parallel manipulation of small objects via learned DCT-based policies that transfer to hardware.

Abstract: Distributed manipulator systems manipulate objects through the coordinated motion of many actuators. However, an object must be supported by several actuators at once, so the centre-to-centre actuator spacing imposes a hard lower bound on manipulable object size. We remove this bound by coupling the end-effectors of an 8 x 8 array of three degrees-of-freedom delta robots with a stretchable fabric, turning 64 discrete contacts into a continuous surface capable of manipulating objects smaller than the actuator spacing. Viewing the array as a displacement field over that surface, we investigate local quasi-static and cyclic fields as manipulation primitives. These primitives can be applied globally across the array or locally confined around each tracked object to independently manipulate several objects in parallel. We then train a policy acting on low-order discrete cosine transform coefficients: at equal action dimension, commanding a nineteen-delta neighbourhood halves the placement error of commanding the whole array. The policy transfers to hardware without adaptation at 76% success. The platform manipulates objects from 15mm-90mm, a six-fold range spanning both sides of the actuator spacing, 43.3mm, on a single surface.

摘要（中文）：分布式机械臂系统通过多个执行器的协同运动来操控物体。然而，由于物体必须同时由多个执行器支撑，执行器中心间距对可操控物体的尺寸设定了严格的下限。为了消除这一限制，我们将一个8×8阵列的三自由度Delta机器人末端执行器与可拉伸织物耦合，将64个离散接触点转变为连续表面，从而能够操控小于执行器间距的物体。将这一阵列视为该表面上的位移场，我们研究了局部准静态场和循环场作为操控基元。这些基元可全局应用于整个阵列，也可局部限制在每个被追踪物体周围，以实现多个物体的并行独立操控。随后，我们训练了一个基于低阶离散余弦变换系数的策略：在相同动作维度下，指令十九个Delta邻域相比指令整个阵列可将放置误差减半。该策略无需适配即可迁移至硬件，成功率达76%。该平台可在单一表面上操控尺寸为15毫米至90毫米的物体，覆盖范围达六倍，跨越执行器间距（43.3毫米）的两侧。

Authors: Bailey Dacre, Andrés Faíña, Oliver Kroemer, Zeynep Temel

Prediction is Better than Detection: Traffic Congestion Control using Drones AutonomousDriving

multi-agent simulation traffic congestion prediction drone fleet provisioning adaptive traffic-signal control closed-loop control

简要说明：本文研究了基于无人机的交通拥堵检测与预测在模拟路网中的应用，结果表明基于预测的交通信号控制将拥堵持续时间减少约两倍，优于基于检测的控制和增加无人机数量。

TLDR: This paper studies drone-based traffic congestion detection and prediction in a simulated network, showing that prediction-driven traffic signal control reduces jam duration twice as much as detection-driven control and outperforms adding more drones.

Abstract: A central question in deploying teams of mobile robots for persistent monitoring is how task performance scales with fleet size, and whether this scaling holds once sensing drives downstream action rather than mere observation. We study this question for a team of drones performing traffic-jam detection and prediction in a simulated road network, whose reports drive an adaptive traffic-signal controller in closed loop. We build a multi-agent simulation, with vehicles following Nagel-Schreckenberg cellular-automaton dynamics and drones patrolling junctions via a round-robin policy, and sweep fleet size, traffic level, and network size to evaluate detection rate, detection delay, and prediction rate. We show how performance plateaus for fleet size approximating the number of junctions being monitored, and offer a general fleet-provisioning rule for persistent-monitoring deployments. More significantly, adapting the signal on a predicted jam, rather than a detected one, roughly doubles the resulting reduction in jam duration, showing that the value of onboard prediction in a sensing-to-action pipeline can exceed the value of adding more robots. Prediction accuracy, not sensing coverage, is now the binding constraint on further improvement, pointing to onboard inference, not fleet size, as the more promising direction for future work.

摘要（中文）：在部署移动机器人团队进行持续监测时，一个核心问题是任务性能如何随机队规模扩展，以及当感知驱动下游行动而非仅仅进行观察时，这种扩展关系是否仍然成立。我们针对一组在模拟路网中执行交通拥堵检测与预测的无人机团队研究该问题，其报告在闭环中驱动自适应交通信号控制器。我们构建了一个多智能体仿真，其中车辆遵循Nagel-Schreckenberg元胞自动机动力学，无人机采用轮询策略巡逻交叉口，并扫描机队规模、交通水平和路网规模，以评估检测率、检测延迟和预测率。我们展示了当机队规模接近被监测交叉口数量时性能趋于平稳的现象，并为持续监测部署提出了一条通用的机队配置规则。更重要的是，基于预测的拥堵而非检测到的拥堵来调整信号，可使拥堵持续时间减少幅度大约翻倍，这表明在感知到行动的处理链中，机载预测的价值可能超过增加机器人数量的价值。预测精度而非感知覆盖，现已成为进一步改进的约束瓶颈，这指向机载推断而非机队规模，是未来工作更有前景的方向。

Authors: Samira Hayat, Christian Raffelsberger

Neuro-Symbolic Predicate Learning for Semantic Safe Robot Control Other

neuro-symbolic safety differentiable reasoner feature learning robot benchmark

简要说明：NEUPRO提出了一种神经符号框架，从符号规则中学习可复用的安全特征，实现可解释的机器人安全，并在新发布的真实机器人基准数据集REASON上进行了验证。

TLDR: NEUPRO introduces a neuro-symbolic framework that learns reusable safety features from symbolic rules for interpretable robot safety, validated on a new real-robot benchmark dataset REASON.

Abstract: As robots are increasingly deployed in everyday environments, ensuring their safety has become a central challenge. Existing methods often encode safety requirements as opaque mathematical/logical formulations or dense cost functions. While effective in specific tasks, they remain difficult to interpret, tightly coupled to individual tasks, and offer limited insight into why a robot action is considered safe or unsafe. To address this limitation, we propose ``Neuro-Symbolic Predicate Learning for Semantic Safe Robot Control'' (NEUPRO), which leverages a differentiable reasoner that can learn reusable safety representations from human-specified safety knowledge. NEUPRO allows practitioners to express task-related safety requirements as transparent symbolic rules, while enabling gradients to propagate through these rules to a feature extractor that maps raw observations to safety-relevant concepts. As a result, the learned feature extractor is (softly) grounded in human-understandable semantics, supports transparent constraint evaluation, and is transferable across tasks. By coupling interpretability with differentiability, NEUPRO moves beyond opaque cost design toward reusable safety reasoning. To evaluate NEUPRO's capability, we collect and release REASON, the first real robot benchmark dataset for interpretable robot safety specification. Experiments on REASON show that NEUPRO learns safety-critical features that generalize across tasks, mitigate the interpretability limitations of conventional black-box cost formulations, and provide explicit explanations of safety violation.

摘要（中文）：随着机器人在日常环境中的部署日益增多，确保其安全性已成为一项核心挑战。现有方法通常将安全要求编码为晦涩的数学/逻辑公式或密集的代价函数。尽管这些方法在特定任务中表现有效，但它们难以解释、与个别任务紧密耦合，并且对机器人行为为何被视为安全或不安全所提供的洞察有限。为应对这一局限，我们提出了“面向语义安全机器人控制的神经符号谓词学习”（NEUPRO），该方法利用一个可微推理器，能够从人类指定的安全知识中学习可复用的安全表征。NEUPRO允许实践者将任务相关的安全要求表达为透明的符号规则，同时使梯度能够通过这些规则传播至将原始观测映射为安全相关概念的特征提取器。由此，学习到的特征提取器（软性地）扎根于人类可理解的语义，支持透明的约束评估，并可跨任务迁移。通过将可解释性与可微性相结合，NEUPRO超越了不透明的代价设计，迈向可复用的安全推理。为评估NEUPRO的能力，我们收集并发布了REASON——首个面向可解释机器人安全规范的真实机器人基准数据集。在REASON上的实验表明，NEUPRO学习到的安全关键特征能够跨任务泛化，缓解了传统黑箱代价公式的可解释性局限，并为安全违规提供明确的解释。

Authors: Zihan Ye, Jiayi Liu, Puze Liu, Jiayun Li, Georgia Chalvatzaki, Jan Peters, Kristian Kersting

ECHO-G: Embodied Co-speech Humanoid mOtion Generation HumanoidEmbodied

co-speech motion humanoid robot diffusion transformer rectified flow robot-space generation

简要说明：ECHO-G 是一个为类人机器人生成全身伴随语音动作的框架，联合基于语音音频和定时文本条件，并包含新的机器人空间数据集和实体机器人部署。

TLDR: ECHO-G is a framework for generating full-body co-speech motion for humanoid robots, jointly conditioned on speech audio and timed transcripts, with a new robot-space dataset and physical robot deployment.

Abstract: Generating full-body co-speech motion for humanoid robots requires coordinating speech prosody, linguistic content, and embodiment-specific motion. To this end, we present ECHO-G, a framework jointly conditioned on speech audio and timed transcripts. Its Speech-Grounded Diffusion Transformer (SGDiT) combines frame-aligned acoustic features with token-level linguistic context, preserving their distinct granularities. Trained with rectified flow matching, it models one-to-many utterance-motion relationships directly in robot space. To support training and evaluation, we introduce a BEAT2-derived audio-text-robot dataset and a benchmark covering co-speech characteristics, robot-motion quality, and runtime efficiency. Comparative evaluation supports direct robot-space generation over the evaluated human-motion generation and retargeting pipelines, while modality ablations highlight the benefits of joint audio-text conditioning. We further demonstrate deployment on a physical humanoid robot. A complementary video-rating study also favors joint conditioning over the alternatives. The dataset and training, inference, and evaluation code are available through our project page.

摘要（中文）：生成人形机器人的全身协同语音动作，需要协调语音韵律、语言内容及机器人特有的动作模式。为此，我们提出了ECHO-G，一个联合基于语音音频和带时间戳文本的框架。其语音接地扩散变换器（SGDiT）将帧级声学特征与词级语言上下文相结合，保留它们各自不同的粒度。通过修正流匹配训练，该模型直接在机器人空间中建模一对多的语句-动作关系。为支持训练与评估，我们构建了源自BEAT2的音频-文本-机器人数据集，以及一个涵盖协同语音特征、机器人动作质量和运行时效率的基准。对比评估表明，直接机器人空间生成优于所评估的人体动作生成与重定向流程，而模态消融实验则凸显了音频-文本联合条件化的优势。我们进一步在实体人形机器人上展示了部署应用。一项补充的视频评分研究也倾向于联合条件化方案。数据集及训练、推理和评估代码均可通过我们的项目页面获取。

Authors: Yizhao Li, Pusen Gao, Ming Wang, Shaojie Shen, Shuo Yang, Hao Xu

Sparse Planner: A Hybrid Planner for Efficient Sampling via a Conditional Variational Autoencoder AutonomousDriving

conditional variational autoencoder sample-based motion planning trajectory planning autonomous driving sampling efficiency

简要说明：本文提出一种基于CVAE的混合规划器，通过学习有效轨迹参数的条件分布来降低自动驾驶中基于采样的运动规划的采样密度和运行时间波动，以八分之一的采样量实现了比FISS+更低的轨迹成本。

TLDR: This paper proposes a CVAE-based hybrid planner that learns conditional distributions of effective trajectory parameters to reduce sampling density and runtime variability in sample-based motion planning for autonomous driving, achieving lower trajectory cost than FISS+ with one-eighth the samples.

Abstract: Trajectory planning is a core component of autonomous driving systems, where real-time performance and solution quality directly affect safety and reliability. Sample-Based Motion Planning (SBMP) is widely adopted for its ability to approximate near-optimal solutions through parameter space sampling. However, achieving high-quality trajectories typically requires dense sampling, leading to substantial computational overhead and significant runtime variability in complex traffic scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose a Sparse Planner (SP) that improves sampling efficiency by learning the conditional relationship between scene context and effective trajectory parameters using a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE). By modeling the structure of high-quality sampling distributions, SP directly generates cost-effective samples in the parameter space, significantly reducing the required sampling density while preserving solution quality. Experimental results show that SP achieves lower trajectory cost than the state-of-the-art FISS+ planner while using only one-eighth of the sampling density. In addition, SP demonstrates improved distance-keeping capability in obstacle-rich scenarios and maintains reduced and more stable runtime characteristics, indicating enhanced computational efficiency and predictable runtime behavior.

摘要（中文）：轨迹规划是自动驾驶系统的核心组成部分，其实时性能与解的质量直接影响行车安全与可靠性。基于采样的运动规划方法（SBMP）因能够通过在参数空间中进行采样来逼近近似最优解而被广泛采用。然而，要获得高质量轨迹通常需要密集采样，这导致计算开销显著增加，并在复杂交通场景中产生较大的运行时间波动。 为解决上述问题，本文提出了一种稀疏规划器（SP），通过利用条件变分自编码器（CVAE）学习场景上下文与有效轨迹参数之间的条件关系，从而提高采样效率。SP通过对高质量采样分布的结构进行建模，能够在参数空间中直接生成具有成本效益的样本，从而在不降低解质量的前提下显著减少所需采样密度。 实验结果表明，在仅使用八分之一采样密度的情况下，SP所生成的轨迹成本仍低于现有最优方法FISS+。此外，SP在障碍物密集场景中展现出更强的保持距离能力，并具有更低且更稳定的运行时间特征，体现出更高的计算效率与可预测的运行行为。

RoboAssist: Interactive Human-Humanoid Planning for Long-Horizon Surgical Assistance HumanoidEmbodied

agent-based planning human-robot interaction task replanning cross-layer safety humanoid robot

简要说明：RoboAssist 提出了一种基于智能体的规划框架，用于长期外科手术辅助人形机器人，通过非对称双轨表示实现动态重规划，并采用跨层安全架构保障导航、交接和运行时安全，在 Unitree G1 模拟场景中验证。

TLDR: RoboAssist presents an agent-based planning framework for long-horizon surgical assistance using a humanoid robot, featuring an asymmetric dual-track representation for dynamic replanning and a cross-layer safety architecture for navigation, handover, and runtime supervision, validated in simulated scenarios with a Unitree G1.

Abstract: Long-horizon surgical assistance requires humanoid robots to coordinate with evolving human activities while maintaining safety across planning and execution. We present RoboAssist, an agent-based framework for interactive human-humanoid planning that integrates workflow reasoning, task coordination, and cross-layer safety. At its core is an asymmetric dual-track representation that separates partially observed human process states from executable robot task sequences. By updating human-process estimates, scene context, and task dependencies online, RoboAssist revalidates the remaining task sequence and replans only the affected suffix when workflow requests change. A cross-layer safety architecture combines preventive navigation regulation, reactive regulation during close-range handover, and independent whole-body runtime supervision. This design couples online task coordination with safety constraints throughout execution. We demonstrate the framework on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot in long-horizon, multi-stage simulated surgical assistance scenarios encompassing multimodal interaction, instrument handling, medical material transport, navigation, and safe human-robot handover. Experiments show multi-stage task completion and adaptation to workflow-request changes. A targeted full-replanning ablation shows that residual replanning reduces plan-update latency and post-update token usage. Separate safety experiments demonstrate complementary protection across navigation, handover, and runtime supervision. Additional results and demonstrations are available online at https://roboassist.github.io.

摘要（中文）：长期手术辅助要求人形机器人在规划与执行过程中，既能与不断变化的人类活动保持协调，又能确保安全性。我们提出了RoboAssist，一个基于智能体的交互式人机协同规划框架，集成了工作流推理、任务协调和跨层安全保障。其核心是一种非对称双轨表示，将部分可观测的人类流程状态与可执行的机器人任务序列分离开来。通过在线更新人类流程估计、场景上下文和任务依赖关系，RoboAssist会在工作流请求发生变化时，对剩余任务序列进行重新验证，并仅对受影响的后续部分进行重新规划。跨层安全架构结合了预防性导航调控、近距离交接过程中的反应式调控，以及独立的全身体运行时监督。该设计在整个执行过程中将在线任务协调与安全约束紧密耦合。我们在Unitree G1人形机器人上，于模拟的长时程、多阶段手术辅助场景中验证了该框架，涵盖了多模态交互、器械操作、医疗物资运输、导航和安全的人机交接。实验结果表明，系统能够完成多阶段任务，并能适应工作流请求的变化。针对性的全量重规划消融实验显示，残差重规划有效降低了计划更新延迟及更新后的令牌使用量。独立的安全实验则验证了导航、交接和运行时监督之间的互补性保护效果。更多结果与演示可在线获取：https://roboassist.github.io。

Authors: Jingwei Jia, Keyu Zhou, Jiewei Wang, Peisen Xu, Xingyuan Zhou, Liang Wang, Jiming Chen, Gaofeng Li, Jin Wang, Shunlei Li

FORTE: Forecasting Occupancy for Spatiotemporal Risk-Aware Planning in Dynamic Environments AutonomousDriving

occupancy grid map prediction latent diffusion model spatiotemporal risk-aware planning non-autoregressive forecasting autonomous navigation

简要说明：FORTE是一个导航框架，用潜在扩散模型非自回归地预测占用栅格地图(OGM)并保持时间一致性，利用时空属性(占用重叠和方向性)在无需目标检测或跟踪的情况下选择风险感知路径。

TLDR: FORTE is a navigation framework that uses a latent diffusion model to predict occupancy grid maps (OGMs) non-autoregressively with temporal consistency, and exploits spatiotemporal properties (occupancy overlap and directivity) to select risk-aware paths for dynamic environments without explicit object detection or tracking.

Abstract: Safe navigation in dynamic environments requires anticipating future environmental states to account for spatiotemporal risks, specifically when and where collisions may occur. To this end, occupancy grid map (OGM) prediction has been widely adopted as an effective approach. However, existing OGM-based navigation methods often struggle to achieve accurate and efficient forecasting and fail to fully exploit the temporal information in predicted OGMs during planning. To address these challenges, we propose FORTE, a navigation framework that directly exploits the spatiotemporal evolution of predicted occupancy from the perspectives of spatiotemporal occupancy overlap and occupancy directivity. Based on these properties, FORTE evaluates multiple topology-distinct paths and selects the suitable one without explicit object detection or tracking. To support online planning, we formulate a latent diffusion model-based OGM predictor that generates the entire forecast horizon in a non-autoregressive manner while maintaining temporal consistency through temporal shift modules. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FORTE outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. For prediction, FORTE achieves up to 215.3% higher IoU and 5.24x faster inference; for navigation, it yields up to a 3.5x higher success rate.

摘要（中文）：在动态环境中实现安全导航，需预测未来的环境状态以评估时空风险，即确定碰撞可能发生的时间与位置。为此，占据栅格图（OGM）预测已被广泛采用，作为一种有效的方法。然而，现有的基于OGM的导航方法往往难以实现准确且高效的预测，并且在规划过程中未能充分利用预测OGM中的时间信息。为应对这些挑战，我们提出FORTE，一种导航框架，直接从时空占据重叠和占据方向性两个角度，利用预测占据状态的时空演变。基于这些特性，FORTE评估多条拓扑不同的路径，并在无需显式目标检测或跟踪的情况下选择合适的路径。为支持在线规划，我们构建了一个基于潜在扩散模型的OGM预测器，以非自回归方式生成整个预测范围，并通过时间移位模块保持时间一致性。大量评估表明，FORTE优于现有最先进的基线方法。在预测方面，FORTE的交并比（IoU）最高提升215.3%，推理速度提升5.24倍；在导航方面，其成功率最高提升3.5倍。

Authors: Hahjin Lee, Young J. Kim

Scale and Selection: What Makes Automatic Harness Evolution Work for Visual-Interface Robot Agents VLA

automatic harness evolution optimizer agent visual-interface robot agents Champion-Challenger selection rollout scale

简要说明：本文表明，基于编码代理的视觉界面机器人策略的提示、工具和控制规则等“harness”可以由优化代理自动改进，并发现 rollout 批次大小和 Champion-Challenger 选择机制是实现可靠提升的关键因素。

TLDR: This paper shows that the harness (prompts, tools, control rules) of a coding-agent-based visual-interface robot policy can be automatically improved by an optimizer agent, and identifies rollout batch size and Champion-Challenger selection as critical factors for reliable gains.

Abstract: When an off-the-shelf coding agent is used directly as a robot policy, observing a browser-based 3D interface through screenshots and acting by posing a virtual target gripper through a few tools, the agent's harness, its prompts, tools, and control rules, largely determines success, and until now it has been written by hand. We show that this harness can be improved automatically by another coding agent, the optimizer agent, and report two findings about what makes it work. First, the number of rollouts the optimizer agent sees per round governs whether the evolved harness is trustworthy, generalizes, and improves steadily. A single rollout is a noisy binary outcome, so with few rollouts per round a revision can be promoted on luck; enlarging the batch raises the signal-to-noise ratio of every promotion decision. Holding rounds fixed and growing the training set from 5 to 100 rollouts, held-out success rises from 47% to 67%, while small training sets overfit, reaching 70% on training tasks but only 54% held-out. Second, the optimizer agent must not be given free rein. With every revision it proposes accepted unconditionally, performance drifts downward within ten rounds as ill-judged edits accumulate; adding the most basic safeguard, Champion-Challenger selection that promotes a revision only if it strictly beats the incumbent on the same fixed evaluation set, turns the same loop into one that raises held-out success from 51% to 67% over 30 rounds. Automatic harness evolution for visual-interface robot agents is thus feasible, but its gains hinge on the rollout scale behind each decision and on how the optimizer agent's revisions are selected.

摘要（中文）：当现成的编码智能体直接用作机器人策略时，通过截图观察基于浏览器的三维界面，并借助少量工具通过设定虚拟目标夹爪来执行操作，该智能体的控制系统、提示词、工具及控制规则在很大程度上决定了成败，而迄今为止这些组件皆为手工编写。我们证明，这一控制系统可由另一个编码智能体——优化智能体——自动改进，并报告了关于其有效性的两项发现。首先，优化智能体每轮观察到的 rollout 数量决定了进化后的控制系统是否可信、是否具备泛化能力以及能否稳定改进。单次 rollout 是一个噪声较大的二元结果，因此若每轮 rollout 数量过少，修订可能仅凭运气获得晋升；增大批规模可提高每次晋升决策的信噪比。在轮次固定的情况下，将训练集从 5 个 rollout 扩展到 100 个，留出成功率从 47% 提升至 67%，而小训练集则出现过拟合，在训练任务上达到 70% 但在留出集上仅为 54%。其次，优化智能体不能被放任自流。若其每次提出的修订均无条件接受，则随着不当编辑的累积，性能在十轮内会逐步下滑；加入最基本的保障机制——冠军-挑战者选择，即仅当修订在相同固定评估集上严格优于当前方案时才予以晋升——可将同一循环转变为在 30 轮内使留出成功率从 51% 提升至 67% 的机制。因此，面向视觉界面机器人智能体的控制系统自动进化是可行的，但其收益取决于每项决策背后的 rollout 规模以及优化智能体修订的筛选方式。

Authors: Zhijie Wei, Ferris Tan, Jinghui Wang

Linear Recurrent Memory Suffices to Distil a World-Model Policy for Robot Air Hockey RLRobot

linear recurrent memory policy distillation world-model policy simulated air hockey memory-dependent control

简要说明：本文研究记忆依赖的机器人气垫球控制是否需要非线性循环动力学，表明从DreamerV3教师模型蒸馏出的线性循环策略在临时跟踪丢失情况下与GRU基线及教师表现相当，提示非线性循环动力学可能并非必需。

TLDR: This paper investigates whether memory-dependent robot air hockey control requires nonlinear recurrent dynamics, showing that a linear recurrent policy distilled from a DreamerV3 teacher matches GRU baselines and the teacher's performance under temporary tracking loss, suggesting nonlinear recurrent dynamics may be unnecessary.

Abstract: Does memory-dependent control need nonlinear recurrent dynamics? We study simulated air-hockey defence under temporary loss of puck tracking. A DreamerV3 teacher outperforms a memoryless policy under tracking loss, while resetting the teacher's recurrent state sharply reduces performance, which demonstrates that the task requires memory. We distil this teacher into compact recurrent policies with a 64 dimensional state, with a combination of a diagonal linear recurrence and an optional rank-$k$ nonlinear innovation while retaining nonlinear observation encoders and action heads. Across five matched seeds, the purely linear recurrent model ($k=0$) matches both the GRU baseline and the teacher throughout the tested range of tracking loss. Increasing nonlinear innovation rank providing no measured benefits. This result is obtained on a fresh test split, which will be only opened after all models and analyses are frozen. The linear model requires fewer recurrent parameters and less computation than GRU, but performs comparably. These results suggest that, for this memory dependent control task, nonlinear representation learning around a simple linear memory mechanism can be sufficient, and that nonlinear recurrent dynamics are not necessarily required. These conclusions are limited to the simulated task, teacher, state dimension, and blackout horizon considered here, and to policies whose observation encoder and action head remain nonlinear.

摘要（中文）：记忆依赖的控制是否需要非线性循环动态？我们研究了在短暂丢失冰球追踪情况下的模拟冰球防守任务。一个DreamerV3教师模型在追踪丢失情况下的表现优于无记忆策略，而重置教师模型的循环状态则会显著降低其性能，这表明该任务确实需要记忆。我们将该教师模型蒸馏为具有64维状态的紧凑循环策略，结合了对角线性递推和可选的秩为$k$的非线性更新项，同时保留非线性的观测编码器和动作输出头。在五组匹配的随机种子下，纯线性递推模型（$k=0$）在测试的整个追踪丢失范围内均与GRU基线和教师模型表现相当。增加非线性更新的秩并未带来可衡量的性能提升。该结果是在全新的测试集上获得的，该测试集仅在所有模型和分析冻结之后才会开放。线性模型相比GRU需要更少的循环参数和计算量，但性能相当。这些结果表明，对于这项记忆依赖的控制任务，围绕简单线性记忆机制进行非线性表示学习可能已经足够，非线性循环动态并非必需。这些结论仅限于本文所考虑的模拟任务、教师模型、状态维度和中断时长，以及观测编码器和动作输出头保持非线性的策略。

Authors: F. Olivia Fan, Oliver Obst

Video2SwimFish: An Automated Pipeline for Reconstructing Controllable Fish Models and Biological Locomotion from Real Fish Videos Other

controllable fish models biological locomotion manifold individual swimming policies multi-view video reconstruction locomotion fidelity benchmark

简要说明：Video2SwimFish 是一种自动流水线，可从真实多视角鱼类视频重建可控的、具有公制尺度的鱼类模型，并学习个体游泳策略，同时发布配对数据集和基准，评估超越任务成功率的运动保真度。

TLDR: Video2SwimFish is an automated pipeline that reconstructs controllable, metrically scaled fish models and learns individual swimming policies from real multi-view fish videos, releasing a paired dataset and benchmark that evaluates locomotion fidelity beyond task success.

Abstract: We present Video2SwimFish, an automated pipeline and benchmark for building controllable fish assets from real-fish videos for underwater embodied AI. Given synchronized multi-view videos of an individual fish, the pipeline reconstructs a metrically scaled deformable mesh from a VLM-selected canonical frame, generates internal articulation adapted to that individual's morphology through a VLM actor-critic loop, and extracts a Biological Locomotion Manifold (BLM) from the fish's observed midline curvature. The BLM provides a low-dimensional action space bounded by real-fish motion, enabling an individual swimming policy to be learned for each reconstructed fish. We release two paired datasets: synchronized top- and front-view recordings of 120 individual fish across 6 species, and the controllable assets and individual swimming policies derived from them. Because every asset is tied to the animal it came from, the dataset supports a benchmark that evaluates locomotion learning not only on task success but on fidelity to that individual in trajectory shape, body curvature, and tail-beat frequency, across trajectory following, reward-free swimming behavior transfer from video, and a downstream case study in which a simulated BlueROV underwater robot captures one of the assets. We find that task success and locomotion fidelity do not necessarily improve together: the method achieving the highest task completion is not the method achieving the highest locomotion fidelity, and we identify faithful reproduction of individual animal locomotion as an open challenge for the community. Project website: https://hangongchen.github.io/video2swimfish-web/.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了Video2SwimFish，一个用于从真实鱼类视频构建可控鱼类资产的全自动流程与基准，旨在服务水下具身智能研究。该流程以单条鱼的多视角同步视频为输入，首先从由VLM（视觉语言模型）选定的标准帧中重建出具有公制尺度的可变形网格，随后通过VLM演员-评论家循环生成适配该个体形态的内部关节结构，并从观测到的鱼体中线曲率中提取“生物运动流形”（Biological Locomotion Manifold, BLM）。该BLM提供了一个以真实鱼类运动为边界约束的低维动作空间，使得每条重建鱼均可学习到个体化的游泳策略。我们发布了两组配对数据集：一组包含6个物种共120条鱼的顶视与前视同步录像；另一组则是由此生成的可控资产及对应的个体游泳策略。由于每一项资产均与其来源动物一一对应，该数据集支持一种基准评估方式，不仅在任务成功率上评估运动学习效果，还在轨迹形状、身体曲率和尾拍频率等方面评估其对该个体运动保真度的影响，涵盖轨迹跟踪、基于视频的无奖励游泳行为迁移，以及一项下游案例研究——模拟BlueROV水下机器人捕获其中一项资产。我们发现，任务成功率与运动保真度并非必然同步提升：获得最高任务完成度的方法并非运动保真度最高的方法，我们将对个体动物运动的忠实复现视为社区面临的一项开放挑战。项目网站：https://hangongchen.github.io/video2swimfish-web/。

Authors: Hangong Chen, Linfeng Cheng, Tahsin Zaman Jilan, Ian Fuller, Lee Caesar, Jiaye Wu, Yantian Zha

Local-Minimum Escaper: Programmatic Subgoal Generation for Robust Navigation in Unknown Environments Other

local-minimum escaper subgoal generation mapless navigation hierarchical framework quadruped robots

简要说明：本文提出LME，一种用于移动机器人导航的编程分层框架，通过显式生成安全子目标来逃离局部最小值，提升未知环境中导航的鲁棒性，并已在差分驱动机器人和四足机器人上验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces LME, a programmatic hierarchical framework for mobile robot navigation that explicitly generates safe subgoals to escape local minima, improving navigation robustness in unknown environments across differential-drive and quadruped robots.

Abstract: Mapless navigation in unknown and partially observable environments remains challenging for mobile robots, particularly when local minima prevent the robot from making progress toward its goal. Existing local navigation methods often lack an explicit mechanism for escaping such situations, while deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches typically learn recovery behaviors implicitly through reward design and policy optimization. In this work, we propose \textbf{LME} (Local-Minimum Escaper), a programmatic hierarchical framework that explicitly generates and reasons subgoals to guide robots out of local-minimum regions. LME operates solely on local observations and selects candidate subgoals using interpretable heuristic criteria that account for both surrounding obstacle geometry and candidate-location safety. A local planner then generates low-level motion commands toward the selected subgoal. This design enables LME to handle environments both with and without local minima within a unified framework, while remaining independent of the underlying local planner and requiring no additional training. Extensive experiments in simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that LME provides robust navigation performance and generalizes to challenging unseen scenarios. Furthermore, the generated subgoals can be used to guide different local planners, substantially improving their ability to escape local minima. Successful deployments on both differential-drive and quadruped robots further demonstrate the practical applicability and generality of the proposed framework.

摘要（中文）：在未知且部分可观测环境中进行无地图导航对移动机器人而言仍具挑战性，尤其是当局部极小值阻碍机器人朝向目标前进时。现有的局部导航方法通常缺乏逃离此类情境的显式机制，而深度强化学习（DRL）方法则往往通过奖励设计和策略优化隐式地学习恢复行为。在本工作中，我们提出了\textbf{LME}（局部极小值逃逸器），一种程序化分层框架，通过显式生成并推理子目标来引导机器人脱离局部极小值区域。LME仅依赖局部观测，并采用可解释的启发式准则选择候选子目标，该准则同时考虑周围障碍物几何形状和候选位置的安全性。随后，局部规划器生成朝向所选子目标的底层运动指令。该设计使LME能够在统一框架内处理存在或不存在局部极小值的环境，同时保持与底层局部规划器的无关性，且无需额外训练。在仿真和真实环境中的大量实验表明，LME提供了稳健的导航性能，并能泛化至具有挑战性的未见场景。此外，生成的子目标可用于引导不同的局部规划器，显著提升其逃离局部极小值的能力。在差速驱动机器人和四足机器人上的成功部署进一步证明了所提出框架的实用性和普适性。

Authors: Yin Gu, Xinming Zhang, Shanze Wang, Siwei Cheng, Wei Zhang

PRICE the Action Chunks: Physical Relational Credit Assignment for Embodied Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

credit assignment action chunks physical relations reinforcement learning vision-language-action

简要说明：PRICE 提出了一种仅从终端结果出发，利用轨迹间的物理关系为动作块分配信用，在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 和真实机器人上提升任务成功率的方法。

TLDR: PRICE introduces a method for assigning action-chunk-level credit in embodied RL using physical relations across trajectories from terminal outcomes alone, improving task success in LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real robots.

Abstract: Outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) post-trains vision--language--action policies using terminal success signals, but assigns the same trajectory-level advantage to every action chunk. A failed episode can thus penalize useful early actions as if they caused the failure. Existing approaches seek finer-grained feedback through learned evaluators, adding task-specific supervision or additional model training. We explore, for the first time to our knowledge, whether physical relations across trajectories can provide action-chunk credit in embodied RL from terminal outcomes alone, without an auxiliary evaluator. The key insight is that rollouts reaching corresponding physical situations can serve as references for one another: their terminal outcomes provide evidence for assessing local progress. We introduce Physical Relations for Inferring Credit from Episodes(PRICE), with two components: (i) a physical relational graph that pools current and historical outcomes at corresponding chunk boundaries to estimate success potentials; and (ii) confidence-gated credit assignment that uses changes in these potentials to refine trajectory-level supervision. Our analysis connects oracle potential changes to the terminal-success objective and provides a finite-sample directional bound for outcome-independent evidence pools. Independent continuation tests show that PRICE's retained credits align with local progress, while experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real robots demonstrate improved task success over outcome-based baselines and faster learning.

摘要（中文）：基于结果的强化学习（RL）通过终端成功信号对视觉-语言-动作策略进行后训练，但将相同的轨迹级优势分配给每个动作块。因此，一次失败的回合可能会惩罚早期有用的动作，仿佛它们导致了失败。现有方法通过学得的评估器寻求更细粒度的反馈，这需要添加任务特定的监督或额外的模型训练。据我们所知，我们首次探索了跨轨迹的物理关系是否能够仅从终端结果出发，在具身强化学习中提供动作块级别的信用分配，而无需辅助评估器。关键洞察在于，到达相应物理状态的轨迹展开可以互为参照：它们的终端结果为评估局部进展提供了证据。我们提出了基于物理关系的回合信用推断方法（PRICE），包含两个组成部分：（i）物理关系图，在相应的动作块边界汇集当前和历史结果以估计成功潜力；以及（ii）置信门控信用分配，利用这些潜力的变化来细化轨迹级监督。我们的分析将预言机潜力变化与终端成功目标联系起来，并为结果无关的证据池提供了有限样本方向性界。独立延续测试表明，PRICE保留的信用与局部进展一致，而在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和真实机器人上的实验则证明了相较于基于结果的基线方法，任务成功率有所提高且学习速度更快。

Authors: Yangang Zou, Jiajun Lu, Weitao Zhou, Haibao Yu, Bozhou Zhang, Jiawei Wang, Honglong Tian, Minglei Li, Li Zhang

DODGER: Safety-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Robot Navigation Among Dynamic Obstacles RLRobot

safety-guided reinforcement learning control barrier functions dynamic obstacles humanoid navigation LiDAR perception

简要说明：DODGER 提出了一种安全引导的强化学习框架，用于在动态障碍物中进行机器人导航，利用控制障碍函数过滤的参考和约束违反来塑造策略学习，无需运行时安全过滤器，并在人形机器人的仿真和真实实验中验证。

TLDR: DODGER presents a safety-guided reinforcement learning framework for robot navigation among dynamic obstacles, using CBF-filtered references and constraint violations to shape policy learning without a runtime safety filter, validated in humanoid simulation and real-world experiments.

Abstract: Robots operating in human-centered environments must safely navigate among multiple dynamic obstacles to avoid collisions with people and surrounding infrastructure. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide an effective mechanism for safety filtering, and recent CBF-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods embed such safety information into learned policies. However, executing only safety-filtered actions during training can restrict policy exploration, a limitation that becomes particularly consequential in dynamic scenes where safety depends on relative robot-obstacle motion. We propose DODGER, a safety-guided RL framework that directly executes policy-generated actions to drive training rollouts while using CBF-filtered references and constraint violations to shape the policy toward collision-avoidance behavior. We evaluate DODGER through a Dubins-car safety analysis and demonstrate goal-directed navigation among multiple dynamic obstacles in full-order humanoid simulation and real-world humanoid experiments using LiDAR-based perception, without a runtime safety filter.

摘要（中文）：在以人为中心的环境中运行的机器人必须在多个动态障碍物之间安全导航，以避免与人员及周边基础设施发生碰撞。控制障碍函数（CBFs）为安全过滤提供了一种有效机制，而近期基于CBF的强化学习（RL）方法将此类安全信息嵌入到学习策略中。然而，在训练过程中仅执行经过安全过滤的动作可能会限制策略的探索，这一局限在动态场景中尤为凸显，因为此类场景下的安全性取决于机器人与障碍物之间的相对运动。我们提出DODGER，一种安全引导的强化学习框架，该框架直接执行策略生成的动作以驱动训练轨迹，同时利用CBF过滤的参考信号和约束违例情况来引导策略形成避碰行为。我们通过Dubins车辆安全性分析对DODGER进行了评估，并在全阶人形机器人仿真及基于LiDAR感知的真实世界人形机器人实验中，展示了其在多个动态障碍物环境中的目标导向导航能力，且无需运行时安全过滤器。

Authors: Sanghyuk Park, Kwanwoo Lee, Taekyung Kim, Seohyeon Lim, Yisoo Lee

Locomotion-Grounded Humanoid Soccer: Task-Gated Reinforcement Learning of a Multi-Directional Kicking Library Locomotion

reinforcement learning humanoid soccer locomotion policy kicking library task gating

简要说明：该论文颠倒了典型的人形足球流程，先训练命令条件下的运动策略，再添加任务门控的踢球技能库，从而在Unitree G1上实现多方向踢球并改善组合能力。

TLDR: The paper inverts the typical humanoid soccer pipeline by training a command-conditioned locomotion policy first, then adding a library of task-gated kicking skills, enabling multi-directional kicks and improved composition on a Unitree G1.

Abstract: Recent humanoid soccer systems make motion tracking the substrate and derive locomotion from it, typically by steering a motion-reference anchor toward the ball. This yields strong shooting results, but locomotion is trained only on the narrow, deterministic command distribution ball approach induces, never evaluated as a capability in its own right. We invert the stack: a general, command-conditioned locomotion policy is trained first as the substrate, and N motion-guided kicking skills are added on top as task-gated layers, so the reachable gait space is set by the locomotion curriculum rather than any reference clip. Because every skill starts from and returns to this same commandable state, locomotion also becomes a composition hub (O(N) transitions rather than O(N^2)), and post-strike stabilisation is handed back to the trained controller rather than scripted per clip. We instantiate this on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 with seven retargeted kicking skills spanning 259.5 degrees of nominal aim direction, including lateral, rearward and weak-foot strikes a single forward-facing reference cannot express, and report shooting accuracy alongside command-tracking, terrain and push-recovery results with the full skill library attached, an axis prior humanoid soccer systems do not report. The library is validated on hardware across forward, lateral, rearward and commanded approaches.

摘要（中文）：近期的仿人足球系统将运动跟踪作为基础，并由此推导出动行为，通常通过将运动参考锚点引导至足球方向来实现。这种方法取得了良好的射门效果，但动策略仅针对足球接近所引发的狭窄、确定性指令分布进行训练，从未将其作为一项独立能力加以评估。我们反转了这一架构：首先训练一个通用的、基于指令条件的动策略作为基础层，然后在其上添加N个由运动引导的踢球技能作为任务门控层，从而使得可达步态空间由动课程设定，而非任何参考片段。由于每个技能都从这一可指令状态出发并最终返回该状态，动策略同时成为组合枢纽（O(N)次转换而非O(N^2)），且击球后的稳定控制交由已训练控制器处理，而非针对每个片段进行脚本化设定。我们在具有29个自由度的Unitree G1上实现了该系统，包含七个重定向踢球技能，覆盖259.5度的标称瞄准方向，包括侧向、后方及弱脚击球——这些是单一前向参考无法表达的，并报告了射门精度以及附带完整技能库的指令跟踪、地形适应和推力恢复结果——这一维度的评估是先前仿人足球系统所未涉及的。该技能库在前向、侧向、后方及指令化接近方式下均通过了硬件验证。

Authors: Abu Hanif Muhammad Syarubany, Jaehyun Jang, Hwanhee Kim, Kyuwon Kim, Seungyeon Ryu, Chang D. Yoo

Path-Following Control and Terramechanics Analysis for Planetary Rovers Under Wheel-to-Wheel Traction Asymmetry Locomotion

planetary rovers path-following control terramechanics skid-steering traction asymmetry

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于纯减速的模型无关路径跟踪控制策略，用于在可变形地形上的滑移转向行星车，避免打滑下陷，并通过真实车辆实验和力测量验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a model-free, deceleration-only path-following control strategy for skid-steering planetary rovers on deformable terrain, which avoids slip-sinkage and is validated with real rover experiments and force measurements.

Abstract: This paper proposes a control strategy for path following that is model-free and relies solely on deceleration for skid-steering planetary rovers navigating deformable loose terrain under continuously imposed traction asymmetry. While conventional controllers that are based on kinematics frequently cause slip-sinkage entrapment by accelerating the wheels during path correction, the proposed approach prevents this failure by setting an upper limit on the maximum commanded velocity. Heading correction is achieved solely through the selective deceleration of the outer wheels, which are located on the outside of the turn, driving them into a negative slip regime to act as a mechanical anchor. The system was evaluated using the four-wheel independent-drive rover EX1 under an asymmetric wheel configuration with different left and right grouser heights that induces significant deviations from the path. Experimental results demonstrate that this deceleration-only control successfully suppresses accumulated lateral drift across various velocity regimes up to 0.7 m/s without causing sinkage. Crucially, direct force measurements from onboard multi-axis sensors provide important empirical evidence of the underlying terramechanics, proving that the targeted deceleration establishes dynamic load equalization across the chassis and completely restores the native thrust capability of the opposite driving wheel.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种无模型、仅依赖减速实现路径跟踪的控制策略，用于在持续施加牵引力不对称条件下、于可变形松散地形上行驶的滑移转向行星巡视器。传统基于运动学的控制器在路径修正过程中通常通过加速车轮来纠偏，这常常导致滑移-下陷耦合失效；而所提方法通过对最大指令速度设置上限来避免此类失效。航向修正完全依靠对转向外侧车轮的选择性减速实现，使外侧车轮进入负滑移状态，充当机械锚点。该系统在四轮独立驱动巡视器EX1上进行了评估，采用左右履齿高度不同的不对称车轮配置，以诱发显著的路径偏离。实验结果表明，这种仅减速控制策略在高达0.7 m/s的各种速度区间内均能有效抑制累积横向漂移，且不会引起下陷。至关重要的是，来自车载多轴传感器的直接力测量为底层地面力学提供了重要的实验证据，证明定向减速能够在底盘上建立动态载荷均衡，并完全恢复对侧驱动轮的固有推力能力。

Authors: Ryuya Matsuoka, Keisuke Takehana, Kentaro Uno, Toshinori Kuwahara, Kazuya Yoshida

IndoorBEV: A Lightweight Real-Time LiDAR BEV Perception System for Indoor Mobile Robots Perception3D

height-aware BEV LiDAR perception embedded real-time semantic BEV maps oriented object detection

简要说明：IndoorBEV 提出了一种轻量级 LiDAR 感知框架，通过高度感知的 BEV 表示和几何条件特征融合，在严格的延迟和内存限制下实现高效的室内移动机器人语义地图构建和物体检测。

TLDR: IndoorBEV presents a lightweight LiDAR perception framework using a height-aware BEV representation and geometry-conditioned feature fusion to achieve efficient semantic mapping and object detection for indoor mobile robots under strict latency and memory constraints.

Abstract: Efficient indoor LiDAR perception is challenging because mobile robots must understand cluttered three-dimensional environments under strict latency and memory constraints. Existing point-based and voxel-based methods often incur substantial computational overhead, whereas conventional bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations improve efficiency at the cost of discarding vertical geometric information. We present IndoorBEV, a lightweight LiDAR perception framework that mitigates this tradeoff through a height-aware BEV representation and geometry-conditioned feature fusion. IndoorBEV summarizes the vertical point distribution in each BEV cell using statistical height features and multi-frequency height encoding, allowing informative three-dimensional cues to be processed efficiently by two-dimensional convolutions. A lightweight encoder then integrates complementary geometric features with multi-scale local representations and compact global scene context. Decoupled dense prediction heads jointly produce semantic BEV maps and oriented object bounding boxes. IndoorBEV contains only 0.6M parameters and requires 2.3 MB of model storage. On an NVIDIA AGX Orin, it uses 21.52 MB of GPU memory per inference and achieves a mean latency of 169.6 ms under a 200 ms perception deadline, with a deadline miss ratio of 1.8\%. Evaluations on simulated scenes, real-world robot scans, and an open-source indoor point-cloud dataset demonstrate a favorable tradeoff among perception accuracy, latency, and memory consumption. These results indicate that explicitly encoding vertical geometry within a compact BEV representation provides an effective approach to resource-efficient indoor LiDAR perception.

摘要（中文）：高效室内激光雷达感知颇具挑战性，因为移动机器人必须在严格的延迟和内存限制下理解杂乱的三维环境。现有的基于点云和基于体素的方法往往带来较高的计算开销，而传统的鸟瞰图表示虽然提升了效率，却以丢失垂直几何信息为代价。我们提出了IndoorBEV，一种轻量级激光雷达感知框架，通过高度感知的鸟瞰图表示和几何条件特征融合来缓解这一权衡。IndoorBEV利用统计高度特征和多频高度编码对每个鸟瞰图单元内的垂直点分布进行概括，使得有信息量的三维线索能够通过二维卷积高效处理。随后，一个轻量级编码器将互补的几何特征与多尺度局部表示及紧凑的全局场景上下文相融合。解耦的密集预测头联合生成语义鸟瞰图和面向目标的定向包围框。IndoorBEV仅包含0.6M参数，模型存储仅需2.3 MB。在NVIDIA AGX Orin上，单次推理仅占用21.52 MB GPU内存，在200毫秒感知时限内平均延迟为169.6毫秒，超时率为1.8%。在仿真场景、真实机器人扫描以及开源室内点云数据集上的评估表明，该方法在感知精度、延迟和内存消耗之间实现了良好的权衡。这些结果表明，在紧凑的鸟瞰图表示中显式编码垂直几何信息，为资源高效的室内激光雷达感知提供了一条有效路径。

Authors: Haichuan Li

TERRA: Terrain-Aware Reconstruction, Retargeting and Control for Musculoskeletal Locomotion Locomotion

terrain-aware retargeting musculoskeletal locomotion reinforcement learning terrain reconstruction contact constraints

简要说明：TERRA 是一个端到端流水线，从运动学数据重建地形几何，在解剖学和接触约束下将动作重定向到肌肉骨骼模型，并训练统一的肌肉驱动控制策略以在多种非平坦地形上运动。

TLDR: TERRA is an end-to-end pipeline that reconstructs terrain geometry from kinematic motion data, retargets motions to musculoskeletal bodies with anatomical and contact constraints, and trains a single muscle-actuated control policy for diverse non-flat terrain locomotion.

Abstract: Recent advances in musculoskeletal modeling and reinforcement learning have enabled muscle-actuated agents to reproduce increasingly complex human motions. Yet these capabilities remain largely confined to flat ground, in part because motion datasets rarely include aligned terrain geometry and because retargeting terrain interactions to complex musculoskeletal bodies is challenging. We present TERRA, an end-to-end pipeline for terrain-aware retargeting and control of musculoskeletal locomotion. From kinematic trajectories alone, TERRA combines terrain priors, estimated contacts, and negative free-space evidence to recover task-relevant support geometry. TERRA further considers anatomical, tendon-continuity, and contact constraints during retargeting. Using the resulting motion-terrain pairs from five datasets, we successfully train a single muscle-actuated control policy on 9.4 hours of diverse locomotion. Across reconstruction, retargeting, and held-out tracking benchmarks, TERRA improves terrain accuracy, sharply reduces anatomical and interaction violations, and achieves the highest observed completion rate over supported terrain families. Overall, TERRA provides a practical route from scene-less motion data to muscle-actuated locomotion over diverse non-flat terrain. Project website: https://cnai.epfl.ch/terra/

摘要（中文）：近期在肌肉骨骼建模和强化学习方面的进展，使得肌肉驱动的主体能够再现越来越复杂的人类运动。然而，这些能力在很大程度上仍局限于平坦地面，部分原因在于运动数据集很少包含对齐的地形几何信息，并且将地形交互重新定位到复杂的肌肉骨骼体上具有挑战性。我们提出了TERRA，一个用于地形感知重定向和肌肉骨骼运动控制的端到端流程。仅从运动学轨迹出发，TERRA结合地形先验、估计接触和负自由空间证据，恢复任务相关的支撑几何形状。TERRA在重定向过程中进一步考虑解剖学、肌腱连续性和接触约束。利用来自五个数据集的运动-地形配对，我们成功地在9.4小时的多样化运动数据上训练了一个单一的肌肉驱动控制策略。在重建、重定向和留出跟踪基准测试中，TERRA提高了地形精度，显著减少了解剖学和交互违规，并在所支持的地形类别中取得了最高的观察完成率。总体而言，TERRA为从无场景运动数据到多样化非平坦地形上的肌肉驱动运动提供了一条实用路径。项目网站：https://cnai.epfl.ch/terra/

Authors: Merkourios Simos, Chengkun Li, Bianca Ziliotto, Alexander Mathis

Yggdrasil: a Layer-First 3D Scene Graph for Real-Time Querying Perception3D

3D scene graph real-time querying scene understanding robotics latency optimization

简要说明：Yggdrasil 提出了一种分层优先的3D场景图，针对生成和消费效率进行优化，支持机器人流程的实时查询。其查询响应速度比基线快121倍，并集成到多个机器人应用中，大幅减少了场景图处理时间。

TLDR: Yggdrasil presents a layer-first 3D scene graph optimized for efficient generation and consumption, enabling real-time querying for robotic pipelines. It achieves up to 121x faster query responses than baselines and integrates into multiple robotics applications, significantly reducing scene graph processing time.

Abstract: Robotic agents use 3D scene graphs (3DSG) to perform tasks ranging from scene understanding to scene interaction. Although an extensive body of work addresses scene graph generation, little attention has been paid to optimizing the graph for consumption, which leaves state-of-the-art perception pipelines to work around their own scene graph and to pay a latency cost that does not fit the real-time budget a perception loop runs on. We present Yggdrasil, the first 3D scene graph designed to be efficient for both generation and consumption: a layer-first hierarchical graph built from generic nodes, edges, and layers, which expresses the representations existing pipelines already produce, indoor or outdoor, flat or hierarchical, while natively answering the positional and semantic queries downstream tasks issue. Against a published DSG baseline, Yggdrasil answers queries up to $121\times$ faster, and every query we measure falls between 2 and 127 microseconds, three to five orders of magnitude inside the 200 microsecond keyframe budget a 3DSG consumer lives in, on both a workstation and embedded class device. We integrate Yggdrasil into three published pipelines spanning human trajectory prediction, object-goal navigation, and human-aware motion planning, where it removes up to 99% of the time each spends on its scene graph. The implementation, benchmark harness, and all three integrations are available online.

摘要（中文）：机器人智能体使用三维场景图（3DSG）来执行从场景理解到场景交互的各种任务。尽管已有大量工作致力于场景图的生成，但在优化场景图以供消费使用方面却鲜有关注，这导致最先进的感知流水线不得不绕开自身的场景图工作，并付出与感知循环实时预算不相匹配的延迟成本。 我们提出了Yggdrasil，这是首个旨在同时实现高效生成与高效消费的三维场景图：一种基于通用节点、边和层构建的层优先分层图，能够表达现有流水线已经生成的各类表示——无论是室内还是室外、平面还是分层结构——同时原生地响应下游任务所提出的位置与语义查询。 与已发表的DSG基线相比，Yggdrasil的查询响应速度快了最多\(121\times\)，我们测得的所有查询耗时均介于2至127微秒之间，比3DSG消费端所处的200微秒关键帧预算快了三到五个数量级——无论是在工作站还是嵌入式设备上均是如此。我们将Yggdrasil集成到了三个已发表的流水线中，涵盖人类轨迹预测、目标导向导航和感知人类运动规划，在这些系统中它消除了各自花费在场景图上最多99%的时间。相关实现、基准测试工具以及全部三个集成均已在线上公开。

Authors: Arshia Akhavan, Ermanno Bartoli, Afnan Algharbi, Alireza Hoseinpur, Iolanda Leite, Bryan Donyanavard

HIGS: Hierarchical Implicit Grids for Joint Geometric and Semantic Scene Understanding Perception3D

hierarchical neural field multiresolution submaps signed distance field vision-language features open-vocabulary grounding

简要说明：HIGS 提出了一种利用多分辨率子图的分层神经场，用于大规模环境下的高效几何与语义联合场景理解，并结合视觉-语言特征实现开放词汇目标定位和 SDF 构建。

TLDR: HIGS introduces a hierarchical neural field using multiresolution submaps for efficient joint geometric and semantic scene understanding in large-scale environments, leveraging vision-language features for open-vocabulary grounding and SDF construction.

Abstract: Neural implicit representations have had a significant impact on scene reconstruction by enabling robots to build continuous, differentiable, and high-fidelity 3D maps. Most existing works focus on geometric reconstruction and lack semantic information for high-level spatial understanding and task planning. Also, as the scale and complexity of the environment increase, neural representations face the challenge of maintaining computational efficiency in back-end optimization. To resolve these two challenges, we introduce a hierarchical neural field that leverages multiresolution submaps to achieve an efficient and scalable implicit representation, and a unified query and decoding mechanism to support both geometric and semantic features. More specifically, the learnable map features can be converted to the output with the query and decoding process for both training and inference. For large-scale representation, we decompose a scene into overlapping submaps and do hierarchical optimization within each local submap, thus enabling scalable computation. To further improve efficiency, we design feature encoders that predict initial hierarchical grid features to substantially reduce the time needed to optimize the submap features from scratch. To correct estimation drift among submaps, we align and fuse them entirely within the implicit feature space, leading to substantial acceleration by avoiding the need to decode the final output. Building upon this efficient hierarchical representation, we embed both geometric features and vision-language latent features into the map, and demonstrate it on both Signed Distance Field (SDF) construction and open-vocabulary object grounding. Our approach significantly improves computation and memory efficiency, maintains high estimation accuracy, and endows the robot with spatial awareness on large-scale real-world benchmarks.

摘要（中文）：神经隐式表示通过使机器人能够构建连续、可微分且高保真的三维地图，对场景重建产生了显著影响。现有的大多数工作侧重于几何重建，缺乏用于高层次空间理解和任务规划的语义信息。此外，随着环境规模和复杂性的增加，神经表示在后端优化中面临保持计算效率的挑战。为解决这两个挑战，我们引入了一种分层神经场，利用多分辨率子地图实现高效且可扩展的隐式表示，并采用统一的查询与解码机制来同时支持几何特征和语义特征。具体而言，可学习的映射特征可通过查询和解码过程转换为输出，适用于训练和推理阶段。对于大规模表示，我们将场景分解为重叠的子地图，并在每个局部子地图内进行分层优化，从而实现可扩展的计算。为进一步提高效率，我们设计了特征编码器，用于预测初始的分层网格特征，大幅减少从零开始优化子地图特征所需的时间。为了校正子地图之间的估计漂移，我们完全在隐式特征空间中对它们进行对齐和融合，通过避免解码最终输出来实现显著的加速。基于这种高效的分层表示，我们将几何特征和视觉-语言潜在特征嵌入到地图中，并在有符号距离场（SDF）构建和开放词汇对象定位任务上进行了验证。我们的方法显著提高了计算和内存效率，保持了较高的估计精度，并使机器人在大规模真实世界基准测试中具备空间感知能力。

Authors: Hanwen Cao, Wenqiang Wu, Kuang-Ting Tu, Mathias Otnes, Jeffrey Delmerico, Rui Wang, Yulun Tian, Nikolay Atanasov

Dense Temporal Motion Retargeting for Legged Robots Locomotion

motion retargeting model predictive control humanoid robot temporal optimization sim-to-real

简要说明：DTMR 提出一种密集时间运动重定向方法，通过 GPU 上的采样 MPC 联合优化时序和控制，使足式机器人能精确执行动态人体动作并迁移到真实机器人。

TLDR: DTMR proposes a dense temporal motion retargeting method that jointly optimizes timing and control via sampling-based MPC on GPU, enabling legged robots to accurately execute dynamic human motions with real-robot transfer.

Abstract: Legged robots can learn expressive whole-body skills from the motions of humans and animals. Due to the morphology gap between the source and the robot, however, the motion must be tailored to the dynamic properties of the robot. In particular, dynamic motions such as a jump require careful adjustment, since their timing and control are interdependent. We propose dense temporal motion retargeting (DTMR), which jointly optimizes timing and control within a single optimization, where dense means that the timing is adjusted for every control step. This dense formulation enables DTMR to deform only the parts of the motion that need a change in timing. The problem is solved with sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) in parallel on a GPU. We evaluate DTMR against baselines on two hours of human motion with four humanoid robots, where the results show that DTMR outperforms baseline methods, particularly on dynamic motions. We also show that allowing more temporal deformation yields more precise retargeting. We further compare DTMR with a baseline that optimizes the temporal dimension, where the result shows that DTMR retargets more precisely under the same deformation budget while being ~19x faster. Lastly, policies trained on our references transfer to a real humanoid robot.

摘要（中文）：腿式机器人能够从人类和动物的动作中学习富有表现力的全身技能。然而，由于源对象与机器人之间存在形态差异，运动必须根据机器人的动力学特性进行适配调整。尤其是跳跃等动态动作，由于其时序与控制相互依存，需要仔细调整。我们提出了稠密时间运动重定向（DTMR）方法，该方法在单一优化过程中联合优化时序与控制，其中“稠密”意味着对每个控制步的时序进行调整。这种稠密公式使得DTMR能够仅对运动中需要改变时序的部分进行变形。该问题通过基于采样的模型预测控制（MPC）在GPU上并行求解。我们使用两小时的人类运动数据及四款人形机器人，将DTMR与基线方法进行了评估，结果表明DTMR在动态动作上尤其优于基线方法。我们还展示了允许更多的时间变形能够实现更精确的重定向。我们进一步将DTMR与一个优化时间维度的基线方法进行比较，结果显示，在相同的变形预算下，DTMR的重定向精度更高，且速度约快19倍。最后，基于我们参考轨迹训练的策略成功迁移到了真实的人形机器人上。

Authors: Jaeryeong Kim, Taerim Yoon, Jin Cheng, Sungjoon Choi, Stelian Coros

Drone Soccer: Learning to Manipulate with Multicopter Downwash Manipulation

downwash aerial manipulation RL drone soccer sim-to-real

简要说明：该论文提出了一个无人机足球任务，无人机利用其下洗气流学习运球，通过建立简化的下洗动力学模型并训练RL策略，实现了向真实世界的迁移。

TLDR: This paper introduces a drone soccer task where a multicopter learns to dribble a ball using its downwash, modeling the airflow and training an RL policy that transfers to real-world deployment.

Abstract: Although multicopter drones are traditionally designed for "perception-only" tasks, like mapping and exploration, recent work has sought to develop Unmanned Aerial Manipulators (UAMs) to solve mobile manipulation tasks. Aerial manipulation performance can be impacted by "downwash," the airflow produced by propellers, but current state-of-the-art UAMs either ignore downwash or treat it as a disturbance. Instead, is it possible to actively use downwash as a tool during manipulation? We design a drone soccer task to explore the feasibility of downwash-based manipulation. Specifically, we develop a simplified downwash dynamics model which we use to train an RL policy to dribble a soccer ball. We further demonstrate that our policy transfers to real world deployment. This work provides key insights into novel manipulation capabilities for multicopters.

摘要（中文）：尽管多旋翼无人机传统上被设计用于“仅感知”任务，如地图绘制和探索，但近期的研究已致力于开发无人机空中机械臂（UAMs）来解决移动操作任务。空中操作性能可能受到“下洗气流”（即螺旋桨产生的气流）的影响，然而当前最先进的UAMs要么忽略下洗气流，要么将其视为干扰因素。那么，我们能否在操作过程中主动利用下洗气流作为一种工具呢？我们设计了一项无人机足球任务，以探索基于下洗气流操作的可行性。具体而言，我们开发了一个简化的下洗气流动力学模型，并利用该模型训练了一个强化学习（RL）策略来实现对足球的运球。我们进一步证明，该策略能够成功迁移至实际场景中的应用。这项工作为多旋翼无人机的新型操作能力提供了关键见解。

Authors: Neelay Joglekar, Bavin Saravanan, Yutong Wang, Varun Kandiyappan, Junyi Geng, Sebastian Scherer

Onboard Vision and MPC Navigation for Underwater Robots: An Open BlueROV2 Platform for Multi-Robot Experiments & Docking RLRobot

Underwater robots Model Predictive Control Onboard vision Autonomous docking BlueROV2

简要说明：本文提出一个开源的BlueROV2平台，将机载视觉与非线性MPC相结合，用于自主导航和对接，并包含多机器人仿真和物理实验。

TLDR: This paper presents an open-source BlueROV2 platform integrating onboard vision with nonlinear MPC for autonomous navigation and docking, including multi-robot simulation and physical experiments.

Abstract: Autonomous underwater robots require robust perception, estimation and control to operate in confined environments. This paper presents an open-source BlueROV2 platform combining onboard vision with nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) for autonomous navigation and docking. The platform integrates an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX and an Intel RealSense D435i stereo camera in a modular pressure housing. Underwater-calibrated stereo depth and realtime object detection provide relative position measurements of nearby BlueROV2 vehicles in the camera and body frames. A quaternion-based estimator fuses external pose and inertial measurements, while an NMPC controller based on a nonlinear six-degree-of-freedom model tracks planned navigation and docking trajectories. To support reproducible development, we also provide open-source physics-based PX4 SITL and Gazebo environments, multi-robot simulation tools and a lowcost physical docking station. Experiments evaluate underwater perception, onboard computational performance, state estimation, trajectory tracking and autonomous docking.

摘要（中文）：自主水下机器人在受限环境中作业时，需要具备稳健的感知、估计与控制能力。本文介绍了一个开源BlueROV2平台，该平台将机载视觉与非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）相结合，用于实现自主导航与对接。该平台在模块化耐压壳体内集成了NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX和Intel RealSense D435i立体相机。经过水下标定的立体深度测量与实时目标检测，可提供附近BlueROV2航行器在相机坐标系和机体坐标系下的相对位置测量值。基于四元数的估计器融合了外部位姿与惯性测量数据，而基于非线性六自由度模型的NMPC控制器则负责跟踪规划的导航与对接轨迹。为支持可复现的开发，我们还提供了基于物理模型的开源PX4 SITL与Gazebo仿真环境、多机器人仿真工具，以及低成本的物理对接站。实验评估覆盖了水下感知、机载计算性能、状态估计、轨迹跟踪及自主对接等方面。

Authors: Victor Nan Fernandez-Ayala, Wiktor Kowalczyk, Cezary Banaszek, Dimos V. Dimarogonas

What to Attend, What to Keep: Skill-Conditioned Visuotactile Representation with Progress-Guided Event Memory Manipulation

visuotactile representation skill-conditioned fusion event memory contact-rich manipulation progress estimation

简要说明：本文提出一种技能条件化的视觉触觉表示与进度引导事件记忆，用于接触丰富的机器人操作，根据技能自适应融合视觉和触觉，并利用稀疏的终止观测记忆改善进度估计并减少延迟。

TLDR: The paper proposes a skill-conditioned visuotactile representation with progress-guided event memory for contact-rich robotic manipulation, adaptively fusing vision and touch based on the skill and using sparse memory of terminal observations to improve progress estimation and reduce delays.

Abstract: Robotic manipulation integrates vision, touch, and language, whose importance shifts across stages: vision guides reaching, while touch, through its evolution over time, decides grasping, alignment, and contact. Yet existing multi-modal manipulation policies typically use fixed temporal contexts and fusion strategies, despite shifts in what each modality contributes across different skills. We study how vision and touch should be combined at the level of primitive skills, asking what each skill needs from each sensor, and propose a skill-conditioned representation in which the queried skill conditions fusion over modality-specific short-term observation tokens while attending to a sparse event memory that retains terminal observations from the last $K$ executed skills. Evaluated by skill progress estimation on three contact-rich tasks, it reduces slip-detection delay by 87% against fine-tuned SOTA progress models, twist-completion delay by 67.5% against a vision-only ablation, and progress error on a blind search task by 92% through sparse event memory. Gains concentrate exactly where completion is defined by contact or task history. More broadly, our results suggest that observation formation not only policy architecture is a central challenge in multi-modal representation. Project Website: http://what-to-attend-what-to-keep.github.io/

摘要（中文）：机器人操作整合了视觉、触觉与语言，其重要性在不同阶段有所转变：视觉引导物体接近，而触觉则通过其随时间的变化，决定抓取、对准与接触。然而，现有的多模态操作策略通常采用固定的时间上下文和融合策略，尽管不同技能中各模态的贡献会发生变化。我们研究了在原始技能层面上视觉与触觉应如何结合，探究每个技能对每种传感器的需求，并提出了一种技能条件化表示，其中查询到的技能条件作用于模态特定的短期观测标记的融合，同时关注一个稀疏事件记忆，该记忆保留最近执行过的K个技能的终态观测。通过对三项接触密集型任务的技能进度评估，该方法相较于微调后的最优进度模型，将滑动检测延迟降低了87%；相较于仅依赖视觉的消融模型，将扭转完成延迟降低了67.5%；通过稀疏事件记忆，在盲搜索任务中将进度误差降低了92%。这些增益恰好集中在由接触或任务历史定义完成度的环节。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，观测的形成方式——而不仅仅是策略架构——是多模态表示中的核心挑战。项目网站：http://what-to-attend-what-to-keep.github.io/

Authors: Amir-Hossein Shahidzadeh, Seungjae Lee, Eadom Dessalene, Shanthosh Raaj Mohanram Mageswari, Soroush Etemad, Furong Huang, Cornelia Fermüller, Yiannis Aloimonos

CADeT: Causal-Aware Deformation Transmission for Indirect Robotic Manipulation of Soft Tissue Manipulation

causal-aware deformation transmission active sensing model predictive control soft tissue manipulation

简要说明：CADeT提出了一种因果感知的变形传递框架，结合结构因果模型与主动探测来识别潜在传递模式并在线估计状态相关的粘附雅可比，从而在机器人辅助微创手术中实现间接软组织形变的信念感知模型预测控制。在dVRK上的仿体和离体猪组织实验中验证了更高的模式识别精度和更快的形状误差收敛。

TLDR: CADeT introduces a causal-aware deformation transmission framework that integrates an SCM with active probing to identify latent transmission modes and estimate a state-dependent adhesion Jacobian, enabling belief-aware model predictive control for indirect soft-tissue manipulation in RAMIS. Validation on a dVRK with phantoms and ex vivo tissue shows improved mode identification and shape-error convergence.

Abstract: Indirect manipulation of deep-seated deformable anatomy inaccessible to the robot is challenging in robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS) because intervening tissues spatially filter deformation transmission. Passive observations can be ambiguous because the Decoupled and Blocked modes may produce similar motion responses. We propose CADeT, a causal-aware deformation transmission framework that integrates structural causal model (SCM) with active sensing to infer a latent transmission mode and estimate a state-dependent adhesion Jacobian online. During normal manipulation, control actions update the mode belief; when ambiguity persists, an additional probing action is selected to improve mode distinguishability. The mode belief and learned Jacobian are incorporated into a belief-aware model predictive controller for indirect target-shape control. Validation in simulation and on the da Vinci research kit (dVRK), using phantom and ex vivo porcine tissues, shows higher mode-identification accuracy and faster shape-error convergence than the evaluated model-free and model-based baselines. These results show that active sensing improves mode identification and indirect deformation control under the evaluated conditions.

摘要（中文）：间接操控机器人无法触及的深层可变形解剖结构，在机器人辅助微创手术（RAMIS）中具有挑战性，因为中间组织会在空间上对形变传递进行滤波。被动观测可能具有模糊性，因为解耦模式和阻塞模式可能产生相似的运动响应。我们提出CADeT，一种因果感知的形变传递框架，将结构因果模型（SCM）与主动感知相结合，以推断潜在的传递模式并在线估计与状态相关的粘附雅可比矩阵。在正常操作过程中，控制动作更新模式置信度；当模糊性持续存在时，选择额外的探测动作以提高模式可区分性。将模式置信度和学习到的雅可比矩阵融入基于置信度的模型预测控制器，以实现间接目标形状控制。在仿真和达芬奇研究套件（dVRK）上，使用体模和离体猪组织进行验证，结果显示，与所评估的无模型和基于模型的基线方法相比，所提方法具有更高的模式识别准确率和更快的形状误差收敛速度。这些结果表明，在所评估的条件下，主动感知能够提高模式识别能力和间接形变控制性能。

Authors: Junlei Hu, Dominic Jones, Pietro Valdastri

Draft: A Parametric Tool for Robot Design Exploration Locomotion

parametric robot design MuJoCo MJCF co-design actuator survey quadruped reinforcement learning

简要说明：Draft 是一个参数化工具，可从参数树直接生成串链机器人的 MuJoCo 模型，无需 CAD，并利用真实执行器和机器人描述的趋势约束自由参数，通过四足机器人的强化学习评估展示设计权衡。

TLDR: Draft is a parametric tool that generates MuJoCo models of serial-chain robots from a parametric tree without CAD, grounding free parameters using trends from real actuators and robot descriptions, and demonstrates design tradeoffs via RL-evaluated quadrupeds.

Abstract: Robot performance is often limited by the cost of iterating on morphology and control together, since every computer-aided design (CAD) change has to be carried into a simulation-ready model before control work begins. Co-design methods attempt to close this gap, but each uses a model generator written for a single platform or lack the use of real-world data to suggest that designs are plausible. We present Draft, a parametric generation tool whose generalized engine compiles any parametric tree of serial chains into a simulation-ready MJCF model, without CAD. It allows engineers to explore design tradeoffs through easily adjustable models and evaluate how changes influence controller performance. Draft grounds the free parameters of each design using trends fitted to a survey of $114$ actuators and $49$ published robot descriptions, so that a generated robot is anchored to real-world hardware. We validate those trends wholistically by building twins of four off-the-shelf robots, whose masses agree to $1.10\times$ geometric mean fold error. Finally, we demonstrate how Draft exposes design tradeoffs by evaluating three quadrupeds through a two-stage reinforcement learning curriculum.

摘要（中文）：机器人性能往往受制于形态与控制协同迭代的成本，因为每次计算机辅助设计（CAD）变更都必须在控制工作开始前转化为可用于仿真的模型。协同设计方法试图弥合这一差距，但每种方法都依赖于为单一平台编写的模型生成器，或缺乏利用真实世界数据来验证设计合理性的能力。我们提出Draft——一种参数化生成工具，其通用引擎可将任意串联链参数化树直接编译为可用于仿真的MJCF模型，无需CAD。该工具使工程师能够通过易于调整的模型探索设计权衡，并评估变更对控制器性能的影响。Draft基于对114个执行器和49个已发表机器人描述数据的趋势拟合，为每个设计的自由参数提供依据，从而确保生成的机器人锚定于真实硬件。我们通过构建四款现成机器人的孪生模型进行整体验证，其质量与几何平均倍数误差一致（1.10倍）。最后，我们通过两阶段强化学习课程评估三种四足机器人，展示了Draft如何揭示设计权衡。

Authors: David Nguyen, Marcelo Coelho, Sangbae Kim

Memorize, Adapt, Ignore: Diagnosing Robot Learning Mechanisms under Training Data Variation VLA

neural tangent kernel domain randomization imitation learning vision-language-action models robotic manipulation

简要说明：本文利用经验神经正切核（NTK）作为诊断工具，刻画机器人操作策略在训练数据变化下是记忆、适应还是忽略，为域随机化设计和捷径学习检测提供实用指导，并通过真实ACT实验验证。

TLDR: This paper uses the empirical neural tangent kernel (NTK) as a diagnostic to characterize how robot manipulation policies memorize, adapt, or ignore training data variations, providing practical guidance for domain randomization and shortcut detection, validated with real-world ACT experiments.

Abstract: Training data variation, whether through designing a domain randomization (DR) scheme in simulation or curating demonstrations for imitation learning, is a primary lever for improving the robustness of robotic manipulation policies. Yet its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood, and practitioners typically select randomization parameters through expensive trial and error. We investigate these mechanisms through a series of case studies, randomizing object size, color, and type as well as scene lighting and linguistic prompts across settings including pick-and-place RL in ManiSkill and fine-tuning of vision-language-action (VLA) models on LIBERO and RoboTwin. We examine both model behavior and internal representations, using the empirical neural tangent kernel (NTK) as our primary diagnostic tool. We show that the NTK distinguishes a shift in the internal learning mechanism from \textit{memorizing} different situations with insufficient variation (e.g.\ learning what to do for a large cube, and what to do for a small cube) to \textit{adapting} to the situation at hand with sufficient variation. An NTK-based signal-to-noise ratio also helps distinguish when policies have learned to \emph{ignore} task-irrelevant factors (e.g.\ treating blue and red cubes identically, instead of learning a blue sub-policy and a red sub-policy). We use these diagnostics to develop practical guidance for designing DR schemes, selecting models, and detecting shortcut learning. We further compare different kinds of representations and validate our findings with real-world hardware experiments using ACT-based imitation learning.

摘要（中文）：训练数据的变化性——无论是通过在仿真中设计域随机化（DR）方案，还是为模仿学习整理示范数据——都是提升机器人操控策略鲁棒性的主要手段。然而，其内在机制仍未被充分理解，从业者通常需要通过代价高昂的试错过程来选择随机化参数。我们通过一系列案例研究来探究这些机制，在多种设置中对物体大小、颜色和类型以及场景光照和语言提示进行随机化，涵盖ManiSkill中的抓取-放置强化学习以及基于LIBERO和RoboTwin的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型微调。我们同时考察模型行为与内部表征，并以经验神经正切核（NTK）作为主要诊断工具。我们表明，NTK能够区分内部学习机制从“记忆”不同情境但变化不足（例如，学习对大立方体该如何操作、对小立方体又该如何操作）向“适应”当前情境且变化充分（即能够根据手头情境灵活调整）的转变。基于NTK的信噪比还有助于判断策略是否学会了“忽略”任务无关因素（例如，将蓝色和红色立方体同等对待，而非分别学习蓝色子策略和红色子策略）。我们利用这些诊断方法，为设计DR方案、选择模型以及检测捷径学习提供了实用指导。我们进一步比较了不同类型的表征，并通过基于ACT的模仿学习在实际机器人硬件实验中验证了我们的发现。
