Authors: Ke Zhang, Danica J. Sutherland, Chao Liu

GestAdapt: Workspace-Conditioned Co-Speech Gesture Generation for Humanoid Robots HumanoidEmbodied

co-speech gesture generation workspace conditioning humanoid robot retargeting user study

简要说明：本文提出GestAdapt，一种面向人形机器人的工作空间条件共语手势生成框架，在生成阶段即适配可用工作空间的约束，相比事后约束的基线方法在自然度和用户偏好上更优。

TLDR: This paper presents GestAdapt, a workspace-conditioned co-speech gesture generation framework for humanoid robots that adapts gestures to available workspace constraints during generation, showing improved naturalness and user preference over post-hoc constrained baselines.

Abstract: Co-speech gestures for robots must adapt not only to speech and embodiment, but also to the workspace available for performing the motion. Since the same speech can be accompanied by different gestures, a robot can respond to workspace constraints, e.g., gestures for speech next to a wall. In these scenarios, the robot should gesture in a suitable motion rather than simply correcting an unconstrained one. To achieve this goal, we present GestAdapt, a workspace-conditioned framework that conditions co-speech gesture generation on a prescribed wrist workspace. The GestAdapt framework learns from six complementary co-speech corpora through a shared motion representation and supports retargeting to different robot embodiments. Quantitative evaluation shows that generated motions remain close to the real-motion distribution while respecting the workspace. In a user study, gestures generated under modified workspace constraints receive a mean quality score of 3.24/5, above our no-workspace variant (2.43/5) and below the reference motions (3.68/5). In a real robot evaluation, all compared motions are retargeted to the Reachy2 humanoid robot under identical workspace constraints. Motions generated with our framework rank first in 69.7\% of comparisons, higher than our no-workspace variant baseline and retargeted ground-truth motions constrained afterward. Overall, the results support adapting gestures to the available workspace during generation, rather than modifying unconstrained trajectories afterward to satisfy workspace constraints, potentially compromising gesture naturalness.

摘要（中文）：机器人伴随言语的共语手势不仅要适应言语和具身形态，还必须适应执行动作时可用的工作空间。由于相同的言语可以伴随不同的手势，机器人能够响应工作空间约束，例如在墙壁旁进行言语时的手势。在这些场景中，机器人应采用合适的动作进行手势表达，而非简单地对无约束手势进行修正。为实现这一目标，我们提出了GestAdapt，一种以工作空间为条件的框架，该框架在指定的腕部工作空间条件下生成共语手势。GestAdapt框架通过共享运动表示从六个互补的共语语料库中学习，并支持向不同机器人形态的重定向。定量评估表明，生成的运动在尊重工作空间的同时，仍保持与真实运动分布接近。在一项用户研究中，在修改后的工作空间约束下生成的手势平均质量得分为3.24/5，高于我们的无工作空间变体（2.43/5），低于参考运动（3.68/5）。在实际机器人评估中，所有比较的运动均在相同工作空间约束下重定向至Reachy2人形机器人。使用我们框架生成的运动在69.7%的比较中排名第一，高于无工作空间变体基线以及事后受约束的重定向真实运动。总体而言，研究结果支持在生成过程中将手势适应于可用工作空间，而非在无约束轨迹生成后再进行修改以满足工作空间约束，从而避免潜在的手势自然度损失。

Authors: Bosong Ding, Xianglin Zhang, Miao Xin, Murat Kirtay, Giacomo Spigler

Learning to Plan from Random Exploration RLRobot

random exploration temporal relations energy-based model planning multiscale cognitive map

简要说明：本文提出了一种从随机探索数据中学习时间对数密度关系的规划方法，无需动作或奖励标签，使用条件能量模型，并在迷宫导航、自我中心导航和操作规划中验证了其有效性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a planning method that learns temporal log-density relations from random exploration data without action or reward labels, using a conditional energy-based model, and demonstrates its effectiveness in maze navigation, egocentric navigation, and manipulation planning.

Abstract: Random exploration reveals how an environment can be traversed before a goal is specified. Can this experience support long-range planning without policy-improvement training? Our random-walk analysis explains what temporal relations contain: short horizons reveal geodesic geometry in the diffusion limit, while longer horizons reveal connectivity between regions before mixing removes these distinctions. We learn these relations with a conditional energy-based model that estimates temporal log-density ratios through horizon-conditioned embeddings. The model is trained on observation pairs by noise-contrastive estimation, without action or reward labels. The planner queries these learned relations at different horizons as it moves toward the goal. At test time, a separate local dynamics model predicts candidate action outcomes, and the temporal model evaluates their progress toward the goal by selecting or aggregating estimated improvements across horizons. The agent executes one action and replans with both models fixed. Experiments demonstrate long-range maze planning from random exploration using states and images. Learned score fields, embedding probes, and planned routes exhibit properties of a multiscale cognitive map. We further demonstrate egocentric navigation from random exploration and manipulation planning from suboptimal data.

摘要（中文）：随机探索揭示了在目标明确之前如何遍历环境。这种经验能否在缺乏策略改进训练的情况下支持长距离规划？我们的随机游走分析阐明了时间关系所包含的内容：短时域在扩散极限下揭示了测地几何结构，而长时域则揭示了区域之间的连通性，直至混合过程消除这些差异。我们通过一种条件能量模型来学习这些关系，该模型利用时域条件嵌入来估计时间对数密度比。该模型通过噪声对比估计在观测对上训练，无需动作或奖励标签。规划器在向目标移动时，在不同时域查询这些学习到的关系。在测试时，一个独立的局部动态模型预测候选动作的结果，而时间模型则通过选择或聚合各个时域上的估计改进来评估这些动作朝目标方向的进展。智能体执行一个动作，并保持两个模型固定不变进行重新规划。实验表明，该方法能够利用状态和图像从随机探索中进行长距离迷宫规划。学习到的评分场、嵌入探针和规划路径展示了多尺度认知地图的特性。我们进一步展示了基于随机探索的自我中心导航以及基于次优数据的操作规划。

Authors: Deqian Kong, Guangyan Sun, Sheng Cheng, Sirui Xie, Bo Pang, Jianwen Xie, Tony Geng, Caiwen Ding, Ying Nian Wu

MEND: Label-Free Detection, Localisation, and Correction of Latent Hallucination in World Models WorldModel

latent world model hallucination detection denoising score matching inference-time correction navigation

简要说明：MEND 提出了一种基于评分的方法，在无标签条件下检测、定位并修正冻结世界模型中的潜在幻觉，通过真实转移训练的单个去噪网络实现。

TLDR: MEND introduces a score-based method to detect, localize, and correct latent hallucination in frozen world models without ground-truth labels, using a single conditional denoising network on real transitions.

Abstract: World Models are appearing as the next major frontier in computer vision. However, their robustness is currently largely unexplored. We identify the phenomenon of hallucination in latent World Models: given a state and an action, the predicted next latent can decode to a scene that never occurs. Because the prediction is statistically ordinary and is fed back autoregressively by the model, the error is both silent and compounding. We study whether such latent hallucination can be detected, localised, and corrected at inference time, on a frozen self-supervised world model in the absence of ground-truth error labels. We introduce Masked Empirical-Bayes Neural Denoising (MEND), a single conditional score network trained by denoising score matching on real transitions, whose score field serves three roles: its magnitude detects hallucination, its per-token field localises it to specific image patches, and it defines an inference-time correction direction. On two navigation environments MEND detects hallucination with an AUROC of up to 0.80 without using actions, exceeding a single-Gaussian density baseline while also localising the error (per-token AUPRC up to 0.87) and correcting it, all from one score field. Our correction reliably reduces single-step latent error and improves predictions. We identify that a part of the error is tangent to the data manifold, hence, we focus on detection and localisation while highlighting promises of the correction.

摘要（中文）：世界模型正成为计算机视觉领域的下一个重大前沿。然而，其鲁棒性目前尚未得到充分探索。我们发现了潜在世界模型中的幻觉现象：给定一个状态和一个动作，预测出的下一个潜在表示可能解码为从未发生过的场景。由于该预测在统计上表现正常，且模型会自回归地将其作为反馈输入，因此这一错误既具有隐蔽性，又具有累积性。我们研究了在推理阶段，是否能够在缺乏真实错误标签的情况下，对冻结的自监督世界模型中的潜在幻觉进行检测、定位和修正。我们提出了掩蔽经验贝叶斯神经去噪方法（MEND），这是一个通过去噪分数匹配在真实转移数据上训练得到的单一条件分数网络，其分数场承担三重作用：其幅度用于检测幻觉，其逐令牌字段将幻觉定位到特定的图像块，并定义了推理阶段的修正方向。在两个导航环境中，MEND在未使用动作信息的情况下，幻觉检测的AUROC高达0.80，超越了单高斯密度基线，同时还能定位错误（逐令牌AUPRC高达0.87）并进行修正，且全部由一个分数场完成。我们的修正方法能够可靠地减少单步潜在错误并改善预测结果。我们发现部分错误与数据流形相切，因此我们重点研究检测与定位，同时展示修正方法的潜力。

Authors: Ali J Alrasheed, Aryan Yazdan Parast, Basim Azam, James Bailey, Naveed Akhtar

Exo2EgoHOI: Hand-Object-Interaction Aware Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation Other

video generation hand-object interaction exocentric-to-egocentric 4D HOI prior gated cross-attention

简要说明：Exo2EgoHOI 提出了一种手-物交互感知的视频生成框架，通过统一的4D HOI先验和对象中心的门控交叉注意力，将第三人称操作视频转换为第一人称视角，并保持交互细节和物体一致性。

TLDR: Exo2EgoHOI introduces a hand-object-interaction-aware video generation framework that translates third-person manipulation videos into first-person views, using a unified 4D HOI prior and object-centric gated cross-attention to preserve fine-grained interactions and object consistency.

Abstract: Egocentric videos of human manipulation provide valuable visual experience for embodied intelligence, yet collecting such data at scale is costly. Exocentric-to-egocentric video generation offers a scalable alternative by transforming abundant third-person manipulation videos into first-person observations. However, existing methods often struggle to faithfully preserve demonstrated hand-object interactions (HOI) across large viewpoint changes due to insufficient fine-grained interaction guidance and weak object-centric anchoring. We present Exo2EgoHOI, an HOI-aware video generative framework for interaction-preserving exocentric-to-egocentric translation. To preserve fine-grained HOI, we introduce a unified 4D HOI prior that combines scene geometry, articulated hand renderings, and dense hand-object relation fields, together with a dual-branch residual adapter for injecting structural and relational cues into the video generation backbone. To preserve object consistency, we introduce Decomposed Gated Cross-Attention, which separately encodes object and background references and adaptively integrates global semantic and local appearance features as object-centric anchors. Experiments on ARCTIC-HOI and Ego-Exo4D demonstrate substantial improvements in object consistency and HOI preservation while maintaining competitive visual fidelity. In particular, on ARCTIC-HOI, Exo2EgoHOI improves object mIoU by 32.3% and reduces MPJPE and PA-MPJPE by 34.7% and 50.0%, respectively, relative to the respective best baseline results. Project page: https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Exo2EgoHOI/.

摘要（中文）：以自我为中心的人类操作视频为具身智能提供了宝贵的视觉经验，然而大规模收集此类数据成本高昂。从外部视角到自我中心视角的视频生成提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，通过将丰富的第三人称操作视频转化为第一人称观察来实现。然而，现有方法往往因缺乏细粒度的交互引导和弱目标中心锚定，而在大幅视角变化下难以忠实保留所演示的手-物交互（HOI）。我们提出Exo2EgoHOI，一种面向交互保持的外部到自我中心视频翻译的HOI感知视频生成框架。为保留细粒度HOI，我们引入统一的4D HOI先验，结合场景几何、关节手部渲染和密集手-物关系场，并配以双分支残差适配器，将结构和关系线索注入视频生成主干网络。为保持目标一致性，我们提出分解门控交叉注意力，分别编码目标和背景参考，并自适应整合全局语义与局部外观特征作为目标中心锚点。在ARCTIC-HOI和Ego-Exo4D上的实验表明，在保持竞争性视觉保真度的同时，目标一致性和HOI保持均取得显著提升。特别是在ARCTIC-HOI上，相较于各最优基线结果，Exo2EgoHOI将目标mIoU提升32.3%，并将MPJPE和PA-MPJPE分别降低34.7%和50.0%。项目页面：https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Exo2EgoHOI/。

Authors: Hongjia Zhai, Xiyu Zhang, Haoran Zhang, Zhichao Ye, Haomin Liu, Guofeng Zhang, Ian Reid, Xingxing Zuo

LOCI: Spatial Linear Memory for Streaming World Models WorldModel

video world models spatial memory linear attention camera geometry streaming

简要说明：LOCI提出了一种用于流式世界模型的混合空间记忆架构，结合键值缓存和由相机几何条件化的循环线性注意力记忆，在保持长视频恒定内存的同时忠实再现重访内容。

TLDR: LOCI introduces a hybrid spatial-memory architecture for streaming world models, combining key-value caches and recurrent linear-attention memory conditioned on camera geometry to faithfully reproduce revisited content in videos while maintaining constant memory for long sequences.

Abstract: When a camera revisits a previously observed region, a video world model should reproduce what was there before. This requires both remembering past observations and retrieving the right one for the current viewpoint. Key-value caches preserve visual detail but grow with video length; recurrent memory is compact but compresses history into a fixed-size state, so individual past observations are no longer directly accessible. We introduce LOCI, a hybrid spatial-memory architecture that keeps both representations. In half of the transformer blocks, main attention keeps a key-value cache of past observations; in the other half, it is restricted to the current chunk and complemented by a recurrent linear-attention memory whose reads and writes are conditioned on projective camera geometry, so viewpoint enters both memory addressing and stored content. Recurrent readouts flow into subsequent cache-backed blocks and supply their queries with accumulated scene context. On the public MIND memory benchmark and on held-out recorded trajectories, LOCI reproduces revisited content more faithfully than representative world models and a same-recipe full-softmax model; with full history, it lowers peak memory at equal length by about 30% relative to full softmax. With a bounded bank of retained observations, it streams long videos at constant memory and remains more faithful than full softmax under the same budget.

摘要（中文）：当相机重新观察之前已经看过的区域时，视频世界模型应当再现该区域此前的内容。这既需要记住过去的观测，也需要针对当前视角检索出正确的历史观测。键值缓存能够保留视觉细节，但会随视频长度增长而扩大；循环记忆虽然紧凑，却将历史压缩为固定大小的状态，因此无法直接访问个别的过去观测。我们提出LOCI，一种混合空间记忆架构，同时保留这两种表征。在一半的Transformer块中，主注意力机制维护过去观测的键值缓存；在另一半块中，主注意力仅限制于当前片段，并由循环线性注意力记忆补充，其读写操作以投影相机几何为条件，从而使视角同时影响记忆寻址和存储内容。循环读出的信息流入后续基于缓存的块中，为其查询提供累积的场景上下文。在公开的MIND记忆基准测试以及保留的录制轨迹上，LOCI对再次访问内容的再现比代表性世界模型以及采用相同方案的全softmax模型更为忠实；在全历史记录下，相比全softmax，同等长度时的峰值内存降低了约30%。在有限的历史观测库预算下，它以恒定内存流式处理长视频，并且在相同预算下仍比全softmax模型更忠实。

Authors: Ji Xia, Tingting Liao, Xuezhi Liang, Hao Li, Guangyi Liu

DyRAD: Radar Novel View Synthesis for Dynamic Driving Scenes AutonomousDriving

radar novel view synthesis range-azimuth-Doppler dynamic driving scenes point-spread function sensor-configuration transfer

简要说明：DyRAD 通过静态背景反射器和运动跟踪的动态点反射器建模动态驾驶场景，渲染距离-方位-多普勒张量，并利用固定解析点扩散函数分离传感器引起的扩散，从而实现零样本传感器配置迁移。

TLDR: DyRAD models dynamic driving scenes with static and motion-tracked dynamic radar reflectors to render range-azimuth-Doppler tensors, using a fixed analytic point-spread function to separate sensor-induced spread from scene geometry, enabling zero-shot sensor-configuration transfer.

Abstract: Reconstructing dynamic driving scenes from recorded sensor data supports closed-loop evaluation of autonomous driving systems by synthesizing observations beyond the original trajectory. Unlike cameras and LiDAR, radar measures radial velocity directly through Doppler. Yet existing radar novel-view synthesis fails to exploit this capability: methods addressing dynamic scenes reconstruct only range-azimuth tensors, while methods that render Doppler assume static scenes. Moreover, because radar processing spreads each reflection across multiple bins, existing representations absorb this spread into scene geometry, causing it to render incorrectly when the viewpoint moves. We present DyRAD, which models dynamic driving scenes using static background reflectors and motion-tracked dynamic point reflectors to render complete range-azimuth-Doppler (RAD) tensors. Reflector velocities are derived from object tracks and projected onto the line of sight, making Doppler both a rendered output and supervision for those tracks. Crucially, we render reflectors through a fixed analytic point-spread function (PSF) derived from the radar's signal-processing chain, preventing sensor-induced spread from being baked into the scene representation. Beyond improving scene reconstruction, this separation also enables zero-shot sensor-configuration transfer, allowing the same reconstructed scene to be rendered under different radar specifications without refitting. We evaluate DyRAD on RADIal, Boreas, and a synthetic benchmark across both on-path poses and displaced viewpoints untested by prior work. On RADIal, DyRAD recovers radar detections in 90.7% of reference-detected objects, compared with 26.9% for the strongest baseline.

摘要（中文）：从记录的传感器数据重建动态驾驶场景，通过合成原始轨迹之外的观测，支持自动驾驶系统的闭环评估。与摄像头和激光雷达不同，雷达通过多普勒效应直接测量径向速度。然而，现有的雷达新视角合成方法未能利用这一能力：处理动态场景的方法仅重建距离-方位张量，而渲染多普勒的方法则假设场景是静态的。此外，由于雷达处理会将每个反射信号扩散到多个单元中，现有表示将这种扩散吸收到场景几何中，导致视角移动时渲染错误。我们提出DyRAD，利用静态背景反射体和运动跟踪的动态点反射体对动态驾驶场景建模，以渲染完整的距离-方位-多普勒张量。反射体速度从目标轨迹中推导并投影到视线方向，使得多普勒既是渲染输出，也是这些轨迹的监督信号。关键在于，我们通过从雷达信号处理链推导出的固定解析点扩散函数来渲染反射体，防止传感器引起的扩散被固化到场景表示中。除了改善场景重建外，这种分离还实现了零样本传感器配置迁移，使同一重建场景无需重新拟合即可在不同雷达规格下渲染。我们在RADIal、Boreas以及一个合成基准上对DyRAD进行评估，涵盖沿路径姿态和先前工作未测试的偏移视角。在RADIal上，DyRAD在90.7%的参考检测目标中恢复了雷达检测，而最强基线仅为26.9%。

Authors: Merav Keidar, Tomer Borreda, Rajalakshmi Nandakumar, Or Litany

AdaOcc: Adaptive 3D Occupancy Prediction for Embodied Tasks Perception3D

3D occupancy prediction embodied tasks adaptive computation sensor fusion point-based

简要说明：本文提出AdaOcc，一种面向具身任务的自适应点基3D占用预测方法，具备双分支编码器以处理异构传感器输入，并通过包含损失改进几何建模，在Occ-ScanNet上达到最先进性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes AdaOcc, an adaptive point-based 3D occupancy prediction method tailored for embodied tasks, featuring a dual-branch encoder for heterogeneous sensor inputs and a containment loss for improved geometric modeling, achieving state-of-the-art results on Occ-ScanNet.

Abstract: Embodied tasks demand accurate, flexible, and semantically rich 3D scene representations. 3D semantic occupancy is well suited to this requirement, as it can model holistic 3D spaces by encoding geometric occupancy along with semantic categories. However, existing occupancy prediction methods struggle to meet practical deployment requirements, such as adapting to varying computing budgets, sensor setups, and observation views. In this paper, we propose a point-based Adaptive 3D Occupancy Prediction method, called AdaOcc, tailored for embodied scenarios. To accommodate heterogeneous sensor inputs, AdaOcc uses an adaptive geometry-guided dual-branch encoder that can support RGB images in various numbers of views with (estimated) depth maps or LiDAR scans. AdaOcc represents occupied regions via sparse semantic points trained with a progressive query learning strategy, allowing the prediction computational budget to be flexibly adjusted through query point numbers and decoder layers. To facilitate high-fidelity geometric modeling for lightweight point-based occupancy learning, we further propose a novel containment loss that regularizes predicted points to reside within valid occupied regions. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves a new state-of-the-art on Occ-ScanNet with considerable performance improvements over previous methods. Moreover, our framework demonstrates strong practical applicability as an adaptive 3D perception module in real-world embodied systems.

摘要（中文）：具身任务要求三维场景表示具备准确性、灵活性和丰富的语义信息。三维语义占用(3D semantic occupancy)通过编码几何占用及语义类别来建模整体三维空间，因此非常契合这一需求。然而，现有的占用预测方法难以满足实际部署要求，例如适应不同的计算预算、传感器配置和观察视角。本文提出了一种基于点的自适应三维占用预测方法，称为AdaOcc，专门针对具身场景设计。为适配异构传感器输入，AdaOcc采用自适应几何引导的双分支编码器，能够支持不同视角数量的RGB图像及其（估计）深度图或激光雷达扫描数据。AdaOcc通过稀疏语义点表示占用区域，并采用渐进式查询学习策略进行训练，从而可通过查询点数量和解码器层数灵活调整预测计算预算。为促进轻量级基于点的占用学习实现高保真几何建模，我们进一步提出了一种新颖的包含损失(containment loss)，对预测点进行正则化以使其位于有效占用区域内。大量实验表明，我们的方法在Occ-ScanNet上取得了新的最先进性能，相较以往方法有显著提升。此外，该框架作为自适应三维感知模块，在真实具身系统中展现出强大的实际应用能力。

Authors: Jinglong Wang, Yunjie Wang, Zhiyang Zhang, Jiawei He, Ye Yuan, Bo Qiu, Jing Zhang

GPU-Accelerated Path-Dependent Marginal Information Gain for Autonomous Exploration Other

GPU-accelerated marginal information gain autonomous exploration depth buffers sampling-based planners

简要说明：本文提出了一种GPU加速的路径依赖边际信息增益计算方法，用于自主探索，通过深度缓冲来高效处理候选路径上的观测重叠，在仿真和真实实验中显著提升速度并缩短覆盖时间。

TLDR: This paper introduces a GPU-accelerated method for computing path-dependent marginal information gain in autonomous exploration, using depth buffers to efficiently account for observation overlap along candidate paths, achieving significant speedups and improved coverage times in simulation and real-world experiments.

Abstract: Autonomous exploration demands that robots continuously evaluate candidate viewpoints based on their expected information gain and execution cost. Sampling-based planners estimate this gain by volumetric raycasting and, due to its computational cost, evaluate candidates under an assumption of mutual independence, ignoring the overlap between viewpoints along the same path. This work presents a GPU-accelerated method for computing path-dependent marginal information gain, where instead of storing and merging the observed unknown voxels along each candidate path, previous observations are represented using depth buffers. Candidate rays are projected into the depth buffers of their ancestors to identify observation overlap and exclude regions expected to be observed. The planning tree is evaluated in depth order to maintain the dependency between viewpoints and their optimized yaws, while candidate nodes and rays at each level are processed in parallel on the GPU. The proposed method stays within 5-10% of the exact marginal gain computed using voxel hash maps, with speed-ups of up to 118x on a desktop GPU and 28x on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. The method was integrated into two sampling-based exploration planners and evaluated in three simulation environments, where marginal gain reduced the time to 95% coverage in five of the six evaluated planner-environment combinations. Real-world experiments also showed a 30% reduction in the time to 95% coverage, as well as earlier exploration termination times.

摘要（中文）：自主探索要求机器人基于预期信息增益和执行成本持续评估候选视角。基于采样的规划器通过体积射线投射来估计这一增益，但由于其计算成本较高，通常在候选视角间相互独立的假设下进行评估，忽略了同一路径上各视角之间的重叠部分。本研究提出了一种基于GPU加速的路径相关边际信息增益计算方法，该方法不再沿每条候选路径存储并合并已观测的未知体素，而是利用深度缓冲区表示先前的观测结果。候选射线被投影至其祖先节点的深度缓冲区中，以识别观测重叠区域并排除预期已被观测的区域。规划树按深度顺序评估，以维持各视角及其优化偏航角之间的依赖关系，同时每一层的候选节点和射线在GPU上并行处理。所提方法与使用体素哈希表计算的精确边际增益相比，误差保持在5%至10%以内，在桌面GPU上加速比高达118倍，在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上加速比达28倍。该方法已集成至两种基于采样的探索规划器中，并在三个仿真环境中进行了评估，在六种规划器—环境组合中的五种里，边际增益将达到95%覆盖率的时间缩短至原时长的相应比例。真实世界实验同样表明，达到95%覆盖率的时间减少了30%，且探索终止时间有所提前。

Authors: João Félix Mendes, Rodrigo Ventura, Meysam Basiri

Active Mapping of Underwater Litter Using Camera-Sonar Fusion Other

active mapping camera-sonar fusion Bayesian occupancy map next-best-view underwater robotics

简要说明：一种用于水下垃圾的主动测绘框架，利用相机和声纳融合以及共享贝叶斯占用图和次优视角优化。

TLDR: An active mapping framework for underwater litter using camera and sonar fusion with a shared Bayesian occupancy map and next-best-view optimization.

Abstract: Marine litter is a growing threat to the underwater ecosystem, driving demand for autonomous survey methods that can locate debris efficiently over large areas. Existing survey methods typically follow predefined paths or operate with a single sensing modality, typically a camera (with image quality suffering in poor-visibility conditions) or sonar (usually noisy and low-resolution). We present an active mapping framework in which a forward-looking sonar and a camera both feed into a shared Bayesian occupancy map, and an optimization problem is solved at each step to decide on the next best view. Candidate viewpoints are scored by a two-term utility that balances exploration of uncertain regions via voxel entropy against exploitation of likely objects. Each sensor is characterized by range- and bearing-dependent detection and false-alarm probability tables determined from data. We evaluate the approach in a realistic underwater simulator, demonstrating that active mapping finds objects faster than a lawnmower coverage pattern, and that the dual-sensor approach works better than using either of the individual sensors.

摘要（中文）：海洋垃圾对水下生态系统构成日益严重的威胁，这推动了对自主调查方法的需求，以在大范围内高效定位碎片。现有的调查方法通常沿预定路径行驶，或仅依赖单一传感模态，通常是摄像头（在低能见度条件下图像质量会下降）或声纳（通常噪声大且分辨率低）。我们提出了一种主动建图框架，在该框架中，前视声纳和摄像头共同输入到一个共享的贝叶斯占用地图中，并在每一步求解一个优化问题，以决定下一个最佳视角。候选视角通过一个双项效用函数进行评分，该函数平衡了通过体素熵探索不确定区域与利用疑似目标之间的权衡。每种传感器均通过由数据确定的与距离和方位相关的检测概率及虚警概率表进行表征。我们在一个逼真的水下模拟器中评估了该方法，结果表明主动建图比割草机式覆盖路径更快地找到目标，且双传感器方法的效果优于单独使用任一传感器。

Authors: David Rete, Patrick Boros, Lucian Busoniu

Markovian Dynamics Enforcer: Feasibility Preserving Correction on Learned Dynamics Manifolds AutonomousDriving

dynamics manifold post-hoc correction trajectory predictor kinematic bicycle model state constraints

简要说明：MaDE 是一种后处理算子，通过将状态转移投影到可行动力学流形上来修正任意神经轨迹预测器，在车辆轨迹上降低动力学残差，但略微增加位移误差。

TLDR: MaDE is a post-hoc operator that corrects arbitrary neural trajectory predictors by projecting state transitions onto a feasible dynamics manifold, reducing dynamics residuals on vehicle trajectories while slightly increasing displacement error.

Abstract: Neural trajectory predictors can reach low prediction error while violating dynamics, actuator limits, or state constraints, especially when controls are unobserved and dynamics are partially specified. We introduce the Markovian Dynamics Enforcer (MaDE), a time-invariant post-hoc operator mapping state-transition proposals onto a learned feasible dynamics manifold, trained on feasible states without ground-truth controls. For each transition it infers a control and recomputes the state through a completion model of known physics plus a learned residual. It then corrects that control by gradient-based inequality reduction, so inequality satisfaction is best-effort within an iteration budget. Since every correction iterate re-enters the completion model, the returned state is dynamically consistent by construction relative to that model and the supplied previous-state anchor. MaDE drives dynamics residuals to essentially zero on fully specified simulated systems, and on an underspecified system leaves a smaller true-dynamics residual than the baselines. Designed to attach to arbitrary predictors, the frozen operator is evaluated downstream of recurrent, structured state-space, and transformer predictors. On recorded vehicle trajectories the one-step residual against a kinematic bicycle model is 0.0071 to 0.0072 for MaDE and 0.1703 to 0.1714 for raw predictors. MaDE raises average displacement error by a factor of 1.57 to 1.83.

摘要（中文）：神经轨迹预测器在违反动力学、执行器限制或状态约束的情况下仍能达到较低的预测误差，尤其是在控制量未被观测且动力学部分已知时。我们提出了马尔可夫动力学强制器（MaDE），一种时不变的后处理算子，将状态转移提议映射到学习得到的可行动力学流形上，并在无真实控制量标注的可行状态上进行训练。对于每个转移，它推断出一个控制量，并通过由已知物理模型加学习残差构成的补全模型重新计算状态。随后，它通过基于梯度的不等式缩减来修正该控制量，使得不等式满足在给定迭代预算内达到尽力而为的效果。由于每次修正迭代都会重新进入补全模型，返回的状态相对于该模型及所提供的前一状态锚点在构造上即满足动力学一致性。MaDE在完全指定的模拟系统上将动力学残差降至几乎为零，在欠指定系统上则留下比基线方法更小的真实动力学残差。该冻结算子设计为可附加到任意预测器之后，在循环神经网络、结构化状态空间模型及Transformer预测器的下游进行评估。在记录的车辆轨迹上，针对运动学自行车模型的一步残差，MaDE为0.0071至0.0072，而原始预测器为0.1703至0.1714。MaDE使平均位移误差增加了1.57至1.83倍。

Authors: Kevin Yu, Tao Guo, Constantinos Antoniou, Panagiotis Angeloudis

General Performance Guarantee for Human Torque Estimation-Based Task-Agnostic Assistive Exoskeleton Control Manipulation

exoskeleton control human torque estimation task-agnostic control matched assistance guarantee

简要说明：本文提出了一个任务无关辅助外骨骼控制的理论框架，保证匹配辅助概率的下界，即使面对未见过的力矩分布也成立，并在上肢外骨骼上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a theoretical framework for task-agnostic assistive exoskeleton control that guarantees a lower bound on matched assistance probability, even on unseen torque distributions, and validates it on an upper-limb exoskeleton.

Abstract: Accurate human torque estimation is crucial for enabling task-agnostic control in robotic exoskeleton systems. However, estimation errors may cause mismatches between the robot assistance and the human intention, degrading controllability and task performance. In this paper, we address this issue by formally defining matched assistance as scenarios in which the robot positively contributes to human movement. Based on this definition, we develop a theoretical framework to design the robot's desired interaction torque that guarantees a lower bound on the matched assistance probability. Importantly, the proposed guarantee holds over the entire torque distribution, including unseen data beyond the training tasks. This provides our method with strong reliability and generalization, both of which are critical for effective exoskeleton control. The proposed strategy is implemented on the ABLE upper-limb exoskeleton and evaluated in a multi-task setup. Experimental results validate the theoretical guarantees and demonstrate that the proposed strategy achieves effective general performance across several tasks, guaranteeing movement smoothness while reducing human physical effort.

摘要（中文）：准确估计人体力矩对于实现机器人外骨骼系统中的任务无关控制至关重要。然而，估计误差可能导致机器人辅助与人类意图之间的不匹配，从而降低可控性和任务表现。本文针对这一问题，将匹配辅助正式定义为机器人对人类运动产生积极贡献的场景。基于这一定义，我们构建了一个理论框架，用于设计机器人的期望交互力矩，以确保匹配辅助概率的下界。重要的是，所提出的保证适用于整个力矩分布，包括训练任务之外的未见数据。这为我们的方法提供了强大的可靠性和泛化能力，这两者对于有效的外骨骼控制都至关重要。所提出的策略已在ABLE上肢外骨骼上实现，并在多任务设置中进行了评估。实验结果验证了理论保证，并表明所提出的策略在多个任务中实现了有效的整体性能，在保证运动平滑性的同时减少了人体的体力消耗。

Authors: Duy Hoang, Bastien Berret, Olivier Bruneau, Laurent Fribourg

Benchmarking EMlog Calibration for Autonomous Surface Vehicles Other

EMLog calibration autonomous surface vehicles Kalman filter velocity estimation DVL

简要说明：本文针对自主水面航行器上的电磁日志（EMLog）校准，使用两种估计流程和真实遥测数据，对四种校准模型进行了比较基准测试，速度估计精度提升71%。

TLDR: This paper presents a comparative benchmarking of four calibration models for electromagnetic logs (EMLogs) on autonomous surface vehicles, using two estimation pipelines and real-world telemetry, achieving a 71% improvement in speed estimation.

Abstract: Accurate velocity measurement is a fundamental requirement for autonomous surface and underwater vehicles. Commonly, velocity is provided by a Doppler velocity log (DVL) sensor, yet it becomes unavailable due to operational altitude constraints. In such situations, electromagnetic logs (EMLogs) provide a critically robust alternative for continuous velocity estimation. However, raw EMLog measurements are inherently corrupted by systematic errors, which need to be calibrated prior mission begins. Currently, a benchmarking comparative evaluation of how different calibration models perform under rapidly changing dynamic sea conditions is missing in the literature. To bridge this gap, this paper presents a comparative model-based calibration methodology that evaluates four distinct calibration models using two different estimation pipelines. The proposed framework is rigorously validated on a unique 221 minutes of continuous real-world telemetry collected from the MARVEL surface vehicle during dynamic sea trials. The dataset contains two different EMLogs and DVL recordings. Experimental results demonstrate that the bias and scale error model implemented with the Kalman filter improves the speed estimation by 71%. We also demonstrate that dynamical manoeuvres further improve the accuracy compared to standard straight-line paths, ultimately delivering a validated, real-time online calibration EMLog approach for autonomous surface vehicles.

摘要（中文）：精确的速度测量是自主水面与水下航行器的一项基本要求。通常，速度由多普勒测速仪（DVL）传感器提供，但因运行高度限制，该传感器可能无法使用。在此类情况下，电磁计程仪（EMLogs）为连续速度估计提供了一种至关重要的稳健替代方案。然而，EMLog原始测量值本质上会受到系统性误差的影响，需要在任务开始前进行校准。目前，文献中尚缺少对不同校准模型在快速变化的动态海况下性能进行对比基准评估的研究。为填补这一空白，本文提出了一种基于模型的比较校准方法，利用两种不同的估计流程对四种不同的校准模型进行评估。该框架在MARVEL水面航行器动态海上试验中采集的221分钟连续真实遥测数据上得到了严格验证，数据集中包含两种不同的EMLog及DVL记录。实验结果表明，采用卡尔曼滤波器实现的偏差与比例因子误差模型可将速度估计精度提升71%。此外，我们还证明，动态机动相较于标准直线航迹能进一步提高精度，最终为自主水面航行器提供了一种经过验证的实时在线校准EMLog方法。

Authors: Samuel Cohen-Salmon, Itzik Klein

Concurrent Semantic Search and Mission Execution for LTL Missions in Unknown Environments RLRobot

LTLf mission semantic search metric-semantic scene graph Vision Language Model (VLM) planning

简要说明：本文提出一种自适应高层规划方法，利用VLM构建的度量-语义场景图，将任务驱动的语义搜索与LTLf任务执行交织进行，提高了未知室内环境中的任务完成率和路径效率。

TLDR: This paper proposes an adaptive high-level planner that interleaves task-driven semantic search using a VLM-built metric-semantic scene graph with LTLf mission execution, improving mission completion and path efficiency in unknown indoor environments.

Abstract: Planning complex missions in unknown environments requires robots to reason simultaneously about what they should do and what they still need to discover. Existing approaches for solving LTLf missions typically assume a known environment, or separate the exploration of the environment from the execution of the mission, while semantic exploration methods look for one target at a time and ignore the mission being executed. To fill this gap, our main contribution is an adaptive high-level planning method that interleaves a task-driven semantic search with the execution of the mission, advancing both in a non-myopic manner. Our method leverages two representations built online, a metric-semantic scene graph, built with a Vision Language Model (VLM), that provides the evidence needed to locate the objects the mission refers to, and the deterministic finite automaton (DFA) encoding the mission, that indicates which of them matter at each mission state. At every planning stage, our planner selects the waypoints that are most valuable for both the semantic search and the advancement of the mission, valuing them over the remaining mission stages in order to avoid blocking states. The selected waypoints are then ordered in a single high-level plan, which is recomputed as new information arrives. In photorealistic indoor environments over five mission types, our method completes more missions than the compared approaches while having to cover less of the environment, and it does so with shorter paths and complying with the restrictions imposed by the mission.

摘要（中文）：在未知环境中规划复杂任务，要求机器人同时推理其应执行的动作以及仍需探索的信息。现有解决LTLf任务的方法通常假设环境已知，或将环境探索与任务执行分离，而语义探索方法则一次仅寻找一个目标，忽略了正在执行的任务。 为弥补这一不足，我们的主要贡献在于提出一种自适应高层规划方法，将任务驱动的语义搜索与任务执行交错进行，并以非短视的方式同时推进两者。该方法利用在线构建的两种表征：一是由视觉语言模型（VLM）构建的度量-语义场景图，提供定位任务所指对象所需的证据；二是编码任务的确定性有限自动机（DFA），指示在每个任务状态下哪些对象是重要的。在每个规划阶段，我们的规划器选择对语义搜索和任务推进都最具价值的航点，并考虑其在剩余任务阶段中的重要性，以避免阻塞状态。随后，所选航点被排序形成单一高层计划，并在新信息到达时重新计算。 在五类任务的光照逼真室内环境中，与对比方法相比，我们的方法完成了更多任务，同时需覆盖的环境范围更小，且路径更短，并严格遵循任务所施加的约束。

Authors: Fernando Salanova Gaspar, David Morilla Cabello, Cristian Mahulea Poleuca, Eduardo Montijano Muñoz

DiFF: Doppler-informed Flow Matching for Human Motion Flow Other

4D mmWave radar human motion flow flow matching Kolmogorov-Arnold Network Doppler cues

简要说明：DiFF提出了一种利用多普勒先验和KAN注意力的生成式流匹配模型，用于从稀疏、噪声的4D毫米波雷达点云中估计3D人体运动流，在真实世界基准上达到了最先进性能。

TLDR: DiFF proposes a generative flow matching model with Doppler-informed priors and KAN attention for 3D human motion flow estimation from sparse, noisy 4D mmWave radar point clouds, achieving state-of-the-art performance on real-world benchmarks.

Abstract: Perceiving human motion via privacy-preserving 4D millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar is critical for next-generation human-robot interaction (HRI), where point cloud scene flow serves as a foundational motion representation. Yet the extreme sparsity and noise of 4D radar point clouds make non-rigid motion flow estimation severely ill-posed--a challenge that existing rigid-centric methods and prior works fail to adequately address, largely because they neglect the rich Doppler velocity cues inherent in 4D radar. We propose DiFF, a generative framework that marries Doppler-informed motion priors with a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN)-based conditional flow matching model. At its core, a KAN-attention mechanism enables expressive feature extraction, while a prior-guided generative process harnesses Doppler cues to regularize the ill-posed solution space. Extensive experiments show that DiFF achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across diverse real-world datasets, reducing 3D endpoint error to the millimeter scale on the mmBody benchmark.

摘要（中文）：通过隐私保护的4D毫米波雷达感知人体运动，对于下一代人机交互（HRI）至关重要，其中点云场景流作为基础的运动表示。然而，4D雷达点云的极度稀疏性和噪声使得非刚性运动流估计存在严重的不适定性——这一挑战是现有以刚体为中心的方法和先前工作未能充分解决的，主要原因在于它们忽略了4D雷达中固有的丰富多普勒速度线索。我们提出了DiFF，一个将多普勒信息运动先验与基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）的条件流匹配模型相结合的生成式框架。其核心在于，KAN注意力机制实现了富有表现力的特征提取，而先验引导的生成过程则利用多普勒线索来规范不适定的解空间。大量实验表明，DiFF在多种真实世界数据集上达到了最先进的（SOTA）性能，在mmBody基准上将3D端点误差降低至毫米量级。

简要说明：AIfred 是一种桌面机器人手臂，通过末端投影仪将 AI 生成的指导直接投射到工作区，在用户研究中相比屏幕式 AI 工具提高了学习迁移和创作输出。

TLDR: AIfred is a desk-based robotic arm with a projector that places AI-generated guidance directly on the workspace, improving learning transfer and creative output compared to screen-based AI tools in a user study.

Abstract: Desk-based learning and creative activities benefit from handwritten engagement. However, current generative AI tools deliver guidance through a separate screen, creating a gap between where users think and where assistance appears. To address this, in this work we design AIfred, a desk-based robotic arm with a projector mounted at the end-effector that places AI-generated guidance alongside handwritten work. AIfred combines workspace perception, context-aware content generation, and robot-mediated projection to support math assignments, image generation, and drawing tasks. In a user study (n = 36), we compared AIfred against ChatGPT (GPT-5.6 Luna) running on a laptop. Both tools performed comparably while assistance was available during the math assignment (6.7 vs. 7.3/10, p = .41), but AIfred improved short-term learning transfer by 60% once assistance was withdrawn (7.0 vs. 4.4/10, p = .003). In addition, independent art and design professors ranked drawings produced with AIfred better in 33 of 36 cases. Our findings indicate that spatially co-located AI assistance benefits tasks whose guidance shares a spatial frame with the work.

摘要（中文）：基于桌面的学习与创意活动受益于手写参与。然而，当前的生成式人工智能工具通过独立屏幕提供指导，在用户思考之处与辅助信息出现之处之间形成了一道鸿沟。为解决这一问题，本研究设计了AIfred——一种桌面机器人手臂，其末端执行器上安装有投影仪，可将人工智能生成的指导内容直接投射到手写作业旁边。AIfred融合了工作区感知、情境感知内容生成以及机器人介导的投影技术，以支持数学作业、图像生成和绘画任务。在一项用户研究（n=36）中，我们将AIfred与运行在笔记本电脑上的ChatGPT（GPT-5.6 Luna）进行了对比。在数学作业提供辅助期间，两种工具表现相当（6.7分对7.3分/10分，p=0.41），但一旦撤除辅助，AIfred将短期学习迁移提升了60%（7.0分对4.4分/10分，p=0.003）。此外，独立艺术与设计教授在36例中有33例评定使用AIfred创作的绘画作品更优。我们的研究结果表明，空间上共置的人工智能辅助对指导内容与工作共享空间框架的任务尤为有利。

Observability Analysis and Online Calibration of Visual-Inertial-Wheel Odometry for 4WIS4WID Mobile Robots Other

visual-inertial-wheel odometry online calibration observability analysis 4WIS4WID mobile robots preintegration

简要说明：本文提出了一种面向四轮独立转向驱动移动机器人的视觉-惯性-轮式里程计框架，通过冗余二维里程计模型实现转向偏移的可观测性与在线标定，并进行了可观测性分析和退化运动表征。

TLDR: The paper presents a visual-inertial-wheel odometry framework with online calibration for 4WIS4WID mobile robots, including a redundant 2D odometry model for observability of steering offsets, preintegration, observability analysis, and degenerate motion characterization.

Abstract: In this paper, we present a visual-inertial-wheel odometry (VIWO) framework with online calibration for four-wheel independently steered and driven (4WIS4WID) mobile robots. We derive a 2D odometry model directly from the four driving velocities and steering angles, using both the longitudinal rolling constraints and the lateral no-slip constraints of all wheels. A preintegration model and analytical Jacobians are developed for efficient filtering and calibration. An observability analysis of the linearized VIWO system shows that a drive-only model makes all steering offsets unobservable, whereas the proposed redundant model restores their observability. The analysis also identifies four standard VINS unobservable directions and three additional directions associated with the arbitrary placement of the odometry reference frame. Furthermore, we characterize several degenerate motions, including zero yaw rate, constant steering, and a non-rolling wheel, and derive the corresponding excitation conditions for the thirteen wheel intrinsics that remain after fixing the odometry frame reference. The performance of the proposed system has been demonstrated in both simulation and real-world experiments on a 4WIS4WID mobile robot.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种带有在线标定功能的视觉-惯性-轮式里程计（VIWO）框架，适用于四轮独立转向与驱动（4WIS4WID）移动机器人。我们直接从四个驱动速度和转向角出发，结合所有车轮的纵向滚动约束和横向无滑动约束，推导出二维里程计模型。为便于高效滤波与标定，进一步开发了预积分模型及解析雅可比矩阵。对线性化VIWO系统的可观测性分析表明，仅采用驱动模型会使所有转向偏置不可观测，而本文提出的冗余模型则恢复了其可观测性。该分析还识别出标准VINS的四个不可观测方向，以及因里程计参考系任意放置而产生的三个附加方向。此外，我们刻画了几类退化运动，包括零横摆角速度、恒定转向及非滚动车轮，并推导了固定里程计参考系后剩余的十三个车轮内参对应的激励条件。所提系统的性能已在仿真及4WIS4WID移动机器人实际实验中得以验证。

Authors: Branimir Ćaran, Vladimir Milić, Bojan Šekoranja, Bojan Jerbić

Why Do Conventional World Models Fail to Learn Cellular Automata? WorldModel

world models cellular automata spatial locality temporal locality temporal stability

简要说明：本文探究了传统世界模型为何无法精确学习元胞自动机，指出了空间/时间局部性和时间稳定性方面的失败模式，并提出了简单的信息流修改，使滚动生成准确率接近完美。

TLDR: The paper investigates why conventional world models fail to learn cellular automata exactly, identifying failure modes in spatial/temporal locality and temporal stability, and proposes simple information-flow modifications that achieve near-perfect rollout accuracy.

Abstract: Although conventional world models - auto-regressive or diffusion models based on transformers or convolutional networks - may learn surface statistics of world dynamics, can they learn the exact world dynamics from its observed history? Leveraging cellular automata as a simple testbed, we find the answer to be no in many cases. Conventional architectures predict most pixels correctly yet rarely complete a rollout: a CNN predicts 96.3% of cells but completes 18.9% of rollouts; a joint diffusion model completes none. We trace the gap to three failure modes of these world models - namely, they fail to exactly capture spatial locality, temporal locality or temporal stability. Simple changes repair each: (1) for spatial locality, two-dimensional rotary positions lift a transformer from 39.1% to 100% on the Game of Life; (2) for temporal locality, handing each token its cell's previous-frame neighbourhood lifts the same transformer from 25.8% to 99.9% on unseen rules; (3) for temporal stability, causal freezing lifts the same diffusion weights from 42.2% to 99.9%. None of the three changes touches the architectural backbone; each only modifies the information flow within it. We also compare joint and ordered sampling on billiards and, in an exploratory study, on a simulated Burgers equation.

摘要（中文）：尽管传统的世界模型——基于Transformer或卷积网络的自回归模型或扩散模型——或许能够学习世界动态的表层统计特征，但它们能否从观测历史中真正学习到精确的世界动态？利用元胞自动机作为简单测试平台，我们发现许多情况下答案是否定的。传统架构能正确预测绝大多数像素，却几乎无法完成一次完整滚动推演：CNN能预测96.3%的元胞，但仅完成18.9%的滚动推演；联合扩散模型则完全无法完成任何一次。我们将这一差距追溯至这些世界模型的三种失效模式，即它们未能精确捕捉空间局部性、时间局部性或时间稳定性。简单的修改即可逐一修复：（1）针对空间局部性，二维旋转位置编码将Transformer在“生命游戏”上的完成率从39.1%提升至100%；（2）针对时间局部性，将每个词元对应的元胞上一帧邻域信息传入同一Transformer，使其在未见规则上的完成率从25.8%提升至99.9%；（3）针对时间稳定性，因果冻结将同一扩散权重下的完成率从42.2%提升至99.9%。这三项修改均未触及架构主干，仅改变了其内部的信息流动方式。此外，我们还在台球模拟中比较了联合采样与有序采样，并在探索性研究中将其应用于模拟Burgers方程。

Authors: Shaoyang Guo, Ziming Liu

Loop-Free Inverse Reinforcement Learning via Sequential Value Recovery with Q-Score Matching Other

inverse reinforcement learning diffusion policy value recovery Q-score matching offline IRL

简要说明：LFIRL 提出了一种无环逆强化学习方法，通过利用扩散策略和顺序值恢复绕过奖励-策略循环，在机器人控制基准上实现了 2-3 倍的加速，同时保持强大的奖励恢复性能。

TLDR: LFIRL introduces a loop-free inverse reinforcement learning method that bypasses reward-policy loops by leveraging diffusion policies and sequential value recovery, achieving 2-3x speedup with strong reward recovery on robot control benchmarks.

Abstract: Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) aims to recover a reward function that explains expert demonstrations. Existing IRL methods typically rely on a bi-level optimization procedure that alternates between reward learning and policy optimization, leading to substantial computational burden and training instability. In this work, we introduce a different route that eliminates policy optimization entirely by leveraging diffusion policies. Our key insight is that a diffusion policy encodes the action-gradient structure of the optimal soft Q function, enabling reward learning to be cast as a sequence of value recovery problems, thereby allowing us to bypass reward-policy loops inherent in prior IRL methods. Specifically, our method proceeds in three stages: (I) recovering the optimal soft Q function via action-gradient matching and estimating the corresponding soft value function (LogSumExp of Q values) in a way inspired by Gumbel regression; (II) calibrating these soft values by inferring a state-dependent offset; (III) extracting the reward by enforcing Bellman consistency. This leads to Loop-Free Inverse Reinforcement Learning (LFIRL), a fully offline algorithm that operates in a simple, loop-free, and sequential manner. LFIRL is simple to implement and significantly improves training efficiency while maintaining strong reward recovery performance. Empirically, across Maze, Franka Kitchen, Adroit Hand Pen, and Push-T benchmarks, LFIRL achieves 2-3x speedup over the fastest baselines, while matching or surpassing state-of-the-art methods in reward recovery quality.

摘要（中文）：逆向强化学习（IRL）旨在恢复能够解释专家示范的奖励函数。现有IRL方法通常依赖于双层优化流程，在奖励学习与策略优化之间交替进行，这导致了巨大的计算负担和训练不稳定性。在本工作中，我们引入了一种不同的路径，通过利用扩散策略彻底消除了策略优化环节。我们的关键洞察在于，扩散策略编码了最优软Q函数的动作梯度结构，使得奖励学习可以被转化为一系列价值恢复问题，从而绕开先前IRL方法中固有的奖励-策略循环。具体而言，我们的方法分为三个阶段：（I）通过动作梯度匹配恢复最优软Q函数，并以受Gumbel回归启发的方式估计相应的软价值函数（Q值的LogSumExp）；（II）通过推断状态相关的偏移量来校准这些软价值；（III）通过强制满足Bellman一致性来提取奖励。由此我们提出了无循环逆向强化学习（LFIRL），这是一种完全离线的算法，以简单、无循环且顺序化的方式运行。LFIRL实现简单，在显著提升训练效率的同时保持了强大的奖励恢复性能。在实验方面，在Maze、Franka Kitchen、Adroit Hand Pen和Push-T基准测试中，LFIRL相比最快的基线方法实现了2-3倍的加速，同时在奖励恢复质量上达到或超越了最先进的方法。

Code to Control: Synthesizing Parameterized Reactive Controllers Other

简要说明：该论文提出了“Code to Control”方法，利用LLM生成Python控制器结构，并通过无导数搜索拟合参数，得到无需LLM推理或规划的反应式策略，在多个任务上优于基于规划的合成方法，并与深度强化学习相当。

TLDR: This paper introduces Code to Control, a method that uses an LLM to synthesize Python controller structures and derivative-free search to fit their parameters, producing reactive policies that run without LLM inference or planning at decision time and outperform planning-based synthesis while remaining competitive with deep RL.

Abstract: Recent LLM-based approaches to control either invoke a language model to select actions or synthesize world models that require planning at every decision, introducing latency that can limit real-time use. We introduce Code to Control, an approach that synthesizes Python controllers which execute directly as policies. Code to Control separates program structure from parameters. An LLM synthesizes the controller structure, while derivative-free search fits its parameters for continuous control using feedback from the environment. Once learned, the resulting controllers require neither LLM inference nor planning at decision time, enabling real-time gameplay and, under our timing protocol, faster action selection than a PPO policy. Across a suite of Atari games, Flappy Bird, and MuJoCo tasks, Code to Control outperforms planning-based program synthesis methods, remains competitive with deep reinforcement learning while using fewer environment interactions, transfers across substantial changes in environment dynamics, and scales to complex locomotion tasks.

摘要（中文）：最近基于大语言模型的控制方法，要么调用语言模型来选择动作，要么合成需要在每次决策时进行规划的世界模型，这引入了可能限制实时使用的延迟。我们提出了“代码到控制”（Code to Control）方法，该方法合成能够直接作为策略执行的Python控制器。代码到控制将程序结构与参数分离。大语言模型合成控制器结构，而无导数搜索则利用环境反馈，为其参数进行连续控制拟合。一旦学习完成，所得到的控制器在决策时既不需要大语言模型推理，也不需要规划，从而能够实现实时游戏，并且在我们设定的时间协议下，其动作选择速度比PPO策略更快。在一系列Atari游戏、Flappy Bird和MuJoCo任务中，代码到控制优于基于规划的程序合成方法，在保持与深度强化学习竞争力相当的同时，使用更少的环境交互次数，能够迁移到环境动态发生显著变化的情境，并扩展到复杂的运动控制任务。

摘要（中文）：摘要： 本报告考察并比较了多种现有的微调与提示方法，并将其应用于自动驾驶领域。其思路是通过在视频数据集上适配大型语言模型（LLM）来对这些方法进行比较。大型语言模型在处理不同类型数据的理解方面已变得极为擅长，而本研究旨在促使我们的主要测试模型SpaceTimeGPT形成对驾驶场景的低维理解。在BDD-X（伯克利深度驾驶解释）数据集上的实验表明，完整的微调框架在若干自动评估指标上表现出良好性能，甚至在部分指标上超越了基线水平。我们还尝试了在VideoLLaVA模型上应用低秩适配（LoRA）与提示工程，并探讨了其局限性。

Authors: Sayak Mallick, Philipp Geiger, Augustin Kelava

Uruqi: Learning Spatial Cognition from Visual Experience VLN

spatial cognition vision-language models camera trajectories self-motion tracking object mapping

简要说明：本文提出了Uruqi，一种空间认知训练方法和基准，利用合成相机轨迹上的密集多轮监督来提升VLM的空间跟踪和建图能力，准确率从15.84%提升至47.73%。

TLDR: This paper introduces Uruqi, a spatial cognition training method and benchmark that uses dense multi-turn supervision over synthesized camera trajectories to improve VLMs' spatial tracking and mapping abilities, achieving significant accuracy gains from 15.84% to 47.73%.

Abstract: Spatial intelligence requires maintaining a coherent understanding of the world as the embodied agent moves. Like humans, the agent must use its own motion to interpret changes across observations and update object locations and spatial relations accordingly. Despite spatial post-training having substantially broadened the spatial intelligence of vision-language models (VLMs), they still struggle with two atomic spatial capabilities: tracking self-motion and mapping the surrounding world during motion. To address this gap, we provide dense multi-turn supervision over interleaved atomic capabilities within each training episode, mimicking the visual experience of a continuously moving agent that reasons as it observes. To scale this up, we synthesize 11,738 motif-driven camera trajectories over a broad range of 3D scenes, supporting self-motion tracking, persistent object mapping, and rich spatial operations within each visual experience. By training models to reason over these atomic questions, our URUQI$_{\mathrm{Syn}}$-8B improves accuracy from 15.84% to 47.73% on our Uruqi benchmark comprising 52k questions across 2.7k episodes. URUQI-SI-Mix-8B further reaches 50.41%, comparable to the 50.08% achieved by GPT-6 Astra. Trained solely on our synthesized data, URUQI$_{\mathrm{Syn}}$-8B achieves an average relative accuracy improvement of 17.13% over its InternVL3-8B backbone across three external spatial benchmarks. These results highlight continuous visual experience as a scalable source of supervision for developing spatial cognition in VLMs.

摘要（中文）：空间智能要求具身智能体在移动过程中保持对世界的一致理解。与人类类似，智能体必须利用自身运动来解读观测之间的变化，并相应地更新物体位置与空间关系。尽管空间后训练已大幅拓展了视觉语言模型（VLM）的空间智能，但它们在两项原子级空间能力上仍存在不足：跟踪自身运动以及在运动过程中映射周围世界。为解决这一缺口，我们在每个训练回合中对交错的原子级能力提供密集的多轮监督，模拟持续移动的智能体在观测过程中进行推理的视觉体验。为扩展规模，我们合成了11，738条基于动机模板的相机轨迹，覆盖广泛的3D场景，支持每次视觉体验中的自运动跟踪、持久物体映射及丰富的空间操作。通过训练模型对这些原子级问题进行推理，我们的URUQI$_{\mathrm{Syn}}$-8B在我们包含2，700余个回合、5.2万个问题的Uruqi基准上将准确率从15.84%提升至47.73%。URUQI-SI-Mix-8B进一步达到50.41%，与GPT-6 Astra所取得的50.08%相当。仅使用合成数据训练的URUQI$_{\mathrm{Syn}}$-8B在三个外部空间基准上，相较于其InternVL3-8B骨干模型，平均相对准确率提升了17.13%。这些结果凸显了连续视觉体验作为可扩展监督来源在培养VLM空间认知方面的潜力。

简要说明：FrameMorrow 提出一种前瞻性帧选择器，通过预测紧凑的未来标记来识别相关的历史帧，以提升长时程视频生成的一致性和动作对齐，适用于包括动作条件世界模型在内的多种生成器。

TLDR: FrameMorrow proposes a prospective frame selector that uses compact predicted future tokens to identify relevant historical frames for long-horizon video generation, improving consistency and action alignment across various generators, including action-conditioned world models.

Abstract: Long-horizon video generation requires models to effectively leverage an increasingly long generation history. As the generated history grows, retaining all previous content becomes increasingly expensive and redundant, making effective historical selection essential. Existing approaches often determine historical relevance based on the current content. However, information relevant to the present is not necessarily useful for future generation, while seemingly less relevant history may become important later. Our key insight is that historical information should be selected according to its relevance to future information needs. Capturing these needs does not require generating the full future; instead, a compact representation of what becomes important next is sufficient to guide historical selection. Building on this insight, we propose FrameMorrow, a prospective frame selector that predicts a small set of prospective tokens representing future information needs and uses them to identify relevant information from history. FrameMorrow selects explicit historical frames rather than model-specific internal states, enabling plug-and-play integration across diverse generators, including closed-source models, with little additional inference cost. We evaluate FrameMorrow across five benchmarks and 11 generative models spanning long-video generation, interactive generation, and action-conditioned world models. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in long-range consistency, visual quality, and action alignment across diverse generation settings.

摘要（中文）：长视频生成要求模型能够有效利用持续增长的生成历史。随着生成历史不断累积，保留所有先前内容变得愈发昂贵且冗余，因此高效的历史选择至关重要。现有方法通常依据当前内容来判断历史相关性。然而，与当前相关的信息未必对未来生成有用，而看似不太相关的历史日后可能变得重要。我们的关键洞见在于，历史信息应依据其与未来信息需求的相关性进行筛选。捕捉这些需求无需生成完整的未来；相反，仅需对下一阶段重要内容的紧凑表征即可引导历史选择。基于这一洞见，我们提出了FrameMorrow，一种前瞻性帧选择器，它预测一小部分代表未来信息需求的前瞻性令牌，并利用它们从历史中识别出相关信息。FrameMorrow选择显式历史帧而非模型特定的内部状态，从而能够以极低的额外推理成本实现跨不同生成器的即插即用集成，包括闭源模型。我们在涵盖长视频生成、交互式生成以及动作条件世界模型的五个基准和11个生成模型上对FrameMorrow进行了评估。大量实验表明，在多种生成设置中，其在长期一致性、视觉质量和动作对齐方面均取得了一致的改善。

Authors: Bo Yin, Xiaobin Hu, Jiaqi Zhao, Shuicheng Yan

Disagreement-Regularized Imitation Learning for Image-Based Continuous Control with Gaussian and Beta Policies RLRobot

imitation learning disagreement-regularized continuous control Gaussian and Beta policies image-based control

简要说明：本文研究了基于图像的连续控制中的分歧正则化模仿学习（DRIL），在CarRacing环境中表明DRIL能显著提升少示范视觉连续控制，而Beta策略在数据充足时表现优异。

TLDR: This paper studies Disagreement-Regularized Imitation Learning (DRIL) for image-based continuous control in CarRacing, showing that DRIL greatly improves few-demonstration visual continuous control while Beta policies are strong with more data.

Abstract: Purpose: Behavior cloning can accumulate errors when a learned controller visits states outside the demonstrated distribution. This study evaluates whether Disagreement-Regularized Imitation Learning (DRIL), which converts disagreement among cloned policies into a reinforcement-learning reward, improves image-based continuous control. Methods: A controlled CarRacing study combines Gaussian and Beta learner policies, demonstrations from either a clipped Gaussian expert or an intrinsically bounded Beta expert, one or 20 trajectories, deterministic and stochastic evaluation, and three retained stages: behavior cloning, the highest 10-episode training-score checkpoint, and the final DRIL checkpoint. The disagreement ensemble contains five Gaussian policies in every variant. Each retained policy is evaluated over 100 procedurally generated episodes. Results: Score-selected DRIL produced its largest gains in the few-demonstration setting, improving over the strongest behavior-cloning mean by 61% with clipped-action demonstrations and by 112% with bounded-action demonstrations. With 20 trajectories, the advantage of DRIL narrowed; in the bounded-action regime, Beta behavior cloning remained about 7% above the best DRIL checkpoint. The experiments also show that the informativeness of the disagreement reward changes with the learner representation and training stage. Conclusion: DRIL can substantially improve few-demonstration visual continuous control, while bounded Beta policies provide strong behavior-cloning performance when more demonstrations are available. The results highlight the joint importance of learner support,ensemble response, and checkpoint selection.

摘要（中文）：目的：行为克隆在学习控制器访问演示分布之外的状态时可能会累积误差。本研究评估了将克隆策略之间的分歧转化为强化学习奖励的分歧正则化模仿学习（DRIL）是否能改善基于图像的连续控制。方法：一项受控的CarRacing研究结合了高斯和Beta学习者策略，演示分别来自截断高斯专家或内在有界Beta专家，使用1条或20条轨迹，进行确定性和随机性评估，并保留三个阶段：行为克隆、最高10局训练得分检查点以及最终DRIL检查点。分歧集成在每个变体中都包含五个高斯策略。每个保留策略均在100个程序生成的回合上进行评估。结果：在少演示场景下，得分选择的DRIL取得了最大增益，与最强行为克隆均值相比，截断动作演示提升了61%，有界动作演示提升了112%。在20条轨迹下，DRIL的优势缩小；在有界动作场景中，Beta行为克隆仍比最佳DRIL检查点高出约7%。实验还表明，分歧奖励的信息量随着学习者表示和训练阶段的变化而改变。结论：DRIL能够显著改善少演示下的视觉连续控制，而在演示数量更多时，有界Beta策略提供了强大的行为克隆性能。结果强调了学习者支持范围、集成响应和检查点选择的共同重要性。
